relations.label: If an erasure of standing must recur rather than happen once, then it has to become a public and recorded institution, since a creditor who cannot see the debt fall keeps collecting; but if its date is also foreseeable and its cost to the debtor nil, lenders stop dealing before it comes (the seventh-year release needed Hillel's prozbul), so the recurring erasure must be either sudden or priced, and recording alone is not what keeps the pardoned in trade.

relations.from: Grudge with a half-life: in a noisy repeated game a player who never forgets a defection locks both players into punishment after one accident, while a player whose grudge expires after a bounded time restores cooperation; the grudge that dies into a trade route must decay faster than accidents recur, so the fertility is a ratio, not a virtue.
relations.to: Law against remembering: after the Thirty Tyrants, Athenians swore not to recall wrongs (mē mnēsikakein) and barred prosecution for acts under the oligarchy, so former enemies could sit in one assembly; everyone still remembered, and what was erased was standing to act on the memory, by public oath.
relations.label: Can recruit: if accidents recur faster than any individual grudge can decay, then a bounded grudge has to be enforced collectively, as an oath not to recall, and the ratio becomes a law.

relations.from: Loosened grip: an estimator that discounts old evidence at a fixed rate can follow a parameter that drifts, whereas one that weights all evidence equally converges on a stale average and becomes unable to register the change; a full log kept beside the estimate changes nothing, since the capacity lives in what the estimate has let go and not in what the archive holds; the capacity is tracking through time, and it exists only because evidence expires in the estimate.
relations.to: Funes' cure: a network that memorizes its training set as a lookup can only repeat it; under weight decay the table is dislodged and a rule circuit that generalizes remains (the grokking reading, speculative); Borges's Funes cannot think because he cannot forget, and the capacity is transfer to unseen cases, impossible while the cases themselves are the answer.
relations.label: If the world is stationary, then discounting old evidence is merely lossy and only the attrition of instances into a rule is fertile; if the world drifts, the same discounting is what keeps the estimator alive: one erasure, fertile or lossy depending on whether the world holds still.

relations.from: Blastema: a salamander's limb cells forget their differentiated state, dedifferentiate into a bud, and regrow the limb, while mammalian cells that keep their state can only scar; what the bud's cells keep is lineage, since axolotl blastema cells remember whether they came from dermis, cartilage, or muscle and do not cross (Yamanaka reprogramming erases that deeper record as well and recovers pluripotency at the price of lineage); the loss is of a state record with the lineage record left standing, and the capacity is a possibility space reopened exactly as far as the erasure went.
relations.to: Organelle by attrition: the ancestor of the mitochondrion lost most of its genome to the host nucleus, and a symbiont that kept its full genome would have remained a guest able to leave; the loss of autonomy is what made two organisms one (the Black Queen hypothesis generalizes this: losing a costly function a neighbor supplies creates obligate partnership); the capacity produced is membership in a larger unit.
relations.label: If the identity erased is not a tissue role but the capacity for independent life, then the part that forgot cannot re-differentiate alone and a reversible forgetting becomes permanent membership.

relations.from: Singer's leak: an oral bard cannot store ten thousand lines verbatim, so a system of formulas develops that regenerates the poem in every performance; when recordings and literacy arrived, Lord watched the regenerative capacity die; the capacity belongs to the medium's inability to retain, not to any one singer's forgetting.
relations.to: Exceptions lost in transit: English shed case and gender where Norse and English adults could not retain each other's inflections, and fixed word order emerged, learnable by strangers (languages with many adult learners tend to simpler morphology; the causal reading is contested); nobody chose the loss, and the capacity, learnability, appears in the successors, not in the losers.
relations.label: If the channel between generations cannot carry the full form, whether verbatim text or complete inflection, then a regenerative system forms in the receivers; in both cases the capacity appears in the successors and the losers get nothing.

exploration.first_question: Which losses of information, memory, record, or skill produce a capacity that retention was blocking, and through what carrier does the loss produce it rather than merely make room?
exploration.changed_question: What must survive an erasure for it to be fertile, and for whom must the erasure be visible? Breath one found that fertile forgettings are layered: they remove a binding layer (instances, identity marks, images, inflections, offenses) while some carrier layer persists. Breath two found that the moment the capacity appears in someone other than the forgetter, the fertility depends on whether they can see the forgetting, and the dependence can run either way.
exploration.new_member: Ceremony of ash: a zero-knowledge proof system's setup produces a secret that must be destroyed and seen destroyed, so participants burn hardware on camera and the system is sound if at least one of them truly forgot; every later proof rests on an erasure the verifier did not perform, and the same secret destroyed in private yields the same physical fact and no usable system.

priorities.item: Grudge with a half-life: in a noisy repeated game a player who never forgets a defection locks both players into punishment after one accident, while a player whose grudge expires after a bounded time restores cooperation; the grudge that dies into a trade route must decay faster than accidents recur, so the fertility is a ratio, not a virtue.
priorities.why: It turns the live question into a quantity: a forgetting is fertile when its decay is faster than the recurrence of what it forgives, so the shape claim can be checked cheaply and then carried into the social members.
priorities.next_question: Simulate a noisy repeated prisoner's dilemma with error rate e and a grudge that expires after L rounds; sweep both and find the band of L·e inside which cooperation survives. Does the fertile band close from above (grudges too long) and below (grudges too short to deter) as the ratio claim predicts?

priorities.item: Thermal amnesia: a gas that kept the memory of how it was poured would have no temperature; mixing spreads every microstate detail into correlations no instrument can follow, leaving only the conserved quantities in reach, and one number then describes the whole and an engine can be designed around it; the detail is not destroyed but lost to access, which is why a spin echo can call dephased spins back before the loss is complete and why a gas that could still be echoed still holds extractable work rather than a temperature (analytical); what survives is exactly the invariants, and few-variable description is bought by that loss.
priorities.why: Low plausibility as anything but an analogy, high generative promise: if few-variable description is bought by histories passing beyond any echo, there may be a forgetting threshold past which a group acquires something like a temperature, and below which no single number can describe it.
priorities.next_question: Build a toy population of agents whose pairwise histories decay at rate r and who trade on those histories; find the r beyond which one aggregate quantity predicts trade volume as well as the full history does. Does a usable 'social temperature' appear only past a forgetting threshold, and does it vanish again if r is too high?

gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing five mechanism claims (synaptic downscaling keeps a ratio, discounting lives in the estimate, thermal detail is lost to access not destroyed, blastema cells keep lineage, discharge must be witnessed but not forecast), relabeling both hinge edges with the Edict of Nantes and the seventh-year release, and cutting Rediscoverable coast as a non-transmission rather than a loss.

neighbors.separating_case: A thermostat's log in a room whose heat source is steady: discounting old readings only adds noise, while collapsing all readings into a setpoint rule is fertile, so Funes' cure applies and Loosened grip does not. Same erasure, opposite verdicts, decided by whether the world holds still.

checks.boundary_case: The forgetful functor, which maps groups to their underlying sets and whose left adjoint produces free groups, is tempting because a universal object is literally born from a forgetting. It is out because nothing was lost: the original stays beside its image, and the 'forgetting' is a projection that can be undone by looking back. The map admits ash, not shadows; extinction learning is excluded on the same ground from the other side, since spontaneous recovery of the fear shows the record was retained. The Fable critic added the spin echo: dephasing spins decay to one clean time constant, a few-variable description bought by losing the phases, yet a single pi pulse brings the whole signal back, so the record was never gone; it is out on the same ground and supplies the general test: a claimed erasure is ash only if no echo can be run on it, which presses on Thermal amnesia (a member only once the correlations are beyond any echo) and reassures Ceremony of ash (a burned laptop admits no echo, which is why it must be watched rather than trusted).
checks.form_inference: The seriation places Founding oblivion beside Law against remembering as if they were a gradient; the edge between them says the step is destructive: announcing a drift-forgetting converts it into a decree-forgetting and restores the grievance, so the two are incompatible rather than adjacent degrees. The Loosened grip / Funes' cure edge is a fork the line hides: one erasure, fertile or lossy according to the world's stationarity. The Grudge → Law against remembering → Discharge chain is a passage between levels (individual ratio, collective oath, recorded institution) that no position in the list could express.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context (2026-09-07): every member names a carrier from a specific loss to a specific capacity and says what survived; the strange members (an engine designed on a gas's inaccessible history, a proof system whose soundness is a burned laptop, an organism made by losing the ability to leave) were kept as stated, and the critic's repairs sharpened mechanisms rather than domesticating them into 'letting go' or 'abstraction'.

name: clocks-that-are-not-clocks
of: Mechanisms by which a present state retains an ordering, a duration, a deadline, or a phase that can be read without any device built to keep time, each named with the inference it licenses that a clock reading would not.
items: Ratchet count: a periodic forcing leaves one increment per cycle, as a tree lays one ring per year and a lake one varve per thaw, so a reader who counts learns how many cycles passed and, from each increment's width, how each cycle went; without a periodic forcing a layered thing is a pile to be ordered, not a count to be read.

Superposition: things that can only be added on top order themselves by stacking, as sediment, an inbox, and a laundry heap each put the later above the earlier; it yields before and after within one pile, nothing across piles, and nothing about how long.

Half-life ledger: a memoryless transformation at a known rate turns a starting ratio into an elapsed time, as radiocarbon reads the years since a tree stopped exchanging carbon with the air; it dates the moment the thing was sealed off from its reservoir, not the thing, so a reused beam dates a forest's death and not the house.

Succession dial: a triggered program of stages, each requiring the last, reads time since the trigger, as the insects on a corpse name the days since death; the same stage means different durations in July and January, so it is a duration only while the temperature record survives and collapses to an ordering of stages once that record is lost.

Sunburn of stones: an ambient flux accumulates in whatever lies open to it, as cosmic rays build nuclides in a boulder from the day a glacier uncovered it, so the dose reads the moment of uncovering; it dates time in the open rather than existence, so a thick boulder rolled to put its shielded underside skyward reads as newborn, and one buried for a millennium and dug out again reads its exposed years, not its age, which no decay clock can be made to do.

Wear as biography: contact with users erodes a thing in proportion to handling, as a coin loses its relief and a stair its middle, so the reading is use-time rather than calendar time; a hoarded coin reads young for its mint year, and that disagreement, not the wear itself, is the information.

Free-running hunger: an internal oscillator entrained to an external cycle keeps its phase after the cue is removed, as a ground squirrel in a windowless room still fattens in autumn, so a body reads where in the year it is without seeing the year; it reads a phase, never a count, and because it drifts in the dark at its own period, the gap between body and sky when the sky is seen again reads how long the cue was gone, a reading a clock that was never entrained cannot give.

Larder countdown: a stock consumed at a rate reads as the time remaining before it is gone, as a winter's grain or a candle reads a deadline rather than an elapsed duration; the deadline is conditional on consumption, so it can be moved by eating less, which no elapsed time can.

Fingerprint match: an irregular pattern in the thing is matched to the same pattern in a reference of known date, as a plank's ring widths lock onto a master chronology or an ash layer onto a named eruption; it yields an absolute date with no rate and no counting, but only where a reference exists, and a pattern too regular to be unique cannot be matched at all.

Drift against corpus: a shared, unreversed drift of usage places a document at a position in a sequence of other documents, as spelling and letterforms date a manuscript; it yields position and coevality, never duration, because no trusted rate exists for how fast a language moves.

One-way rite: an act that can happen only once partitions time into before and after, as a coronation, an initiation, or the breaking of a jar's seal does, so a life reads as a vector of which irreversibles have occurred; it says which side of a threshold one stands on and never how far from it.

Lattice of rites: in an invented society whose only marks of age are unrepeatable rites that may be taken in more than one order, one person is older than another only when every rite of the second is a rite of the first, so incomparable elders exist and precedence between them must be negotiated rather than measured; a society with one fixed sequence of rites has a line, not this lattice.

Vector clock: each participant counts its own irreversibles and learns the others' counts only when messages arrive, so events order by what could have influenced what, as vector timestamps do in a distributed system; for some pairs it reports that no order exists, which is a fact about causation no clock can state and no single tally, whether a Lamport timestamp or a notched stick, can state either, and it never yields a duration.

Contract calendar: a stipulated rate applied to a stipulated origin makes an amount owed read as elapsed time, as interest would in a village that kept no calendar but its debts; nothing physical ages and the amount was written by whatever calendar the parties had, so the duration lives only in the agreement, a dispute about how long it has been becomes a dispute about the rate, and the duration is enforceable exactly to the extent the agreement is.

Queue clock: the length of a line reads as the wait of the next arrival, given the throughput, as the line at the mill tells the whole town the same afternoon; the reading is shared and reflexive, since those who read it as too long leave and shorten it, so this clock is changed by being read.

Lag as ruler: a state preserved in transit arrives as old as the journey, as starlight and a letter carried up a road of known length do, so the reader learns how stale the news is and what the source was, not what it is; nothing accumulates in the thing, the delay is the whole reading, and it is silent about the source's present.

Frozen dictionary: a mind that stops updating at departure is dated, on return, by the gap between what it knows and the live present, as the returnee who still uses the old street name and the old prices; it dates the severance rather than the person, and the set of missed changes is an inventory of the interval, not merely its length.

Milk on the step: an expected cadence that goes unanswered reads time since the last presence, as bottles accumulating on a doorstep count the days since anyone took one in and a houseplant not yet wilted bounds them from above; nothing is written into the absent person, a neighbor's cadence does the counting, and where nothing accumulates, as with the Sunday call that did not come, the reading falls from a count to a bound held only in the reader's expectation.

source.register: Observed physical and social mechanisms (rings, decay, coins, corpses, queues, debts, manuscripts, doorsteps) with analytical statements of what each licenses; Vector clock is a real engineering construct; Lattice of rites is one explicitly invented-world limit case.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions over illustrative cases; physical rates and fluxes are cited as illustration, not certified; Lattice of rites is speculation with its modality kept visible.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy of dating methods; one object can carry several of these at once (a coin has a mint year, wear, and patina), and the list makes no claim to cover every way a state retains time.
The itinerary orders where the comparison state is kept, not accuracy, antiquity, or reliability; map edges are conditional authored claims, not measured dependencies.
Lattice of rites is invented: no claim that any society orders age this way. Vector clock is a real engineering construct; the passage drawn between them is an authored analogy, not a derivation.

Physical rates and fluxes (half-lives, cosmogenic dose, insect succession) are cited as illustrations of a mechanism, not certified; forensic and geochronological practice is far more conditional than one sentence can carry.

The item type excludes the world's own cycles (sun, tide, season) by fiat, because they retain nothing, and excludes built timekeepers by intent rather than physics (an unmarked candle is in, a candle with hour marks is out; a tally of events is in, a tally of days is out), which places Contract calendar exactly on the line; a different item type would admit them and would produce a different list.

seriation.axis: Where the second state that makes time readable is kept: from inside the aged thing itself, through its peers and a stipulated convention, to the live present, and finally to an expectation held only by the reader.
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scale of accuracy or age. It opens where the thing carries the whole comparison (a tree carries its own rings; a pile carries its own stacking, so Superposition sits second, beside Ratchet count) and closes where it carries none (the absent person carries nothing; a neighbor's cadence does the counting). Half-life ledger, Succession dial and Sunburn of stones follow because each needs one second state from outside the thing (a starting ratio, a temperature record, a flux); Sunburn, Wear as biography and Free-running hunger then sit together as things read against the world's cycle, Wear being the first break: the object retains a record, but of use rather than time. Larder countdown → Fingerprint match is the passage from a comparison the thing supplies to one its peers supply. Lag as ruler → Frozen dictionary is the hinge: the same staleness, read against the live present, measures a distance while the source still emits and a severance once it has stopped. Lattice of rites is placed between One-way rite and Vector clock because the passage from a bit to a partial order is what it exists to show. Superposition was moved from eighth to second on the critic's argument that the itinerary should match its own axis.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does a present state retain an ordering, a duration, or a deadline without any device built to keep time, and what does each let someone infer that a clock would not?
exploration.changed_question: Readable time is always a comparison between two states, and time that merely passed is time that left no second state. Where does the second state live, in the aged thing, in its peers, in a stipulated convention, in the live present, or only in the reader's expectation, and what does each location date: the thing, its sealing, its use, its severance, or its absence?
exploration.new_member: Milk on the step: an expected cadence that goes unanswered reads time since the last presence, as bottles accumulating on a doorstep count the days since anyone took one in and a houseplant not yet wilted bounds them from above; nothing is written into the absent person, a neighbor's cadence does the counting, and where nothing accumulates, as with the Sunday call that did not come, the reading falls from a count to a bound held only in the reader's expectation.

priorities.item: Queue clock: the length of a line reads as the wait of the next arrival, given the throughput, as the line at the mill tells the whole town the same afternoon; the reading is shared and reflexive, since those who read it as too long leave and shorten it, so this clock is changed by being read.
priorities.why: The only member whose reading alters what it reads; whether reflexivity makes a queue a better or worse clock than Little's law predicts is checkable in an afternoon with a notebook.
priorities.next_question: At one visible line with a steady server, record its length and each newcomer's actual wait for an hour, and note who leaves on sight: does balking make the length a sharper predictor of wait, because the line self-trims, or a duller one, because the population that stays is biased?

priorities.item: Lattice of rites: in an invented society whose only marks of age are unrepeatable rites that may be taken in more than one order, one person is older than another only when every rite of the second is a rite of the first, so incomparable elders exist and precedence between them must be negotiated rather than measured; a society with one fixed sequence of rites has a line, not this lattice.
priorities.why: Low plausibility as anthropology, high generative promise: it forces seniority, inheritance, and debt to survive the loss of a total order of ages, and it sits exactly between a social bit and an engineering partial order.
priorities.next_question: Write precedence rules for a six-rite society in which rites form a lattice rather than a line; find the smallest lattice where two people are each the other's elder by some rite, and name the institution that would have to exist to settle a dispute between them without inventing a clock.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing seven items whose illustrations or claims let built timekeepers back in (a postmark, a dead man's switch, a Lamport tally, a village that computes its own interest), correcting Milk on the step's bound-versus-count claim, relabeling the lattice-to-interest incompatibility, and sharpening the tally-stick boundary, and moving Superposition to the opening beside Ratchet count so the itinerary matches its axis.

neighbors.left: Half-life ledger: a memoryless transformation at a known rate turns a starting ratio into an elapsed time, as radiocarbon reads the years since a tree stopped exchanging carbon with the air; it dates the moment the thing was sealed off from its reservoir, not the thing, so a reused beam dates a forest's death and not the house.
neighbors.right: Succession dial: a triggered program of stages, each requiring the last, reads time since the trigger, as the insects on a corpse name the days since death; the same stage means different durations in July and January, so it is a duration only while the temperature record survives and collapses to an ordering of stages once that record is lost.
neighbors.separating_case: A corpse and a beam from the same fire. The beam's radiocarbon reads years since the tree died, indifferent to everything that happened after and to the climate it lay in. The insects on the corpse read days since death, but the same stage means different durations in July and January; lose the temperature record and the succession reading falls to an ordering of stages, while the decay reading keeps its duration.

checks.boundary_case: The shadow of a stick, the sundial's principle, tells the hour but retains nothing: cover the sun and the ground forgets. The item type requires a state that carries time forward, so the sky's cycles are the world's clock and not a member; the ground squirrel is admitted only because its phase survives in the dark. The critic's case marks the other side of the line: a candle with hour marks cut into the wax is the medieval candle clock and is out, while the unmarked candle stays in as a Larder countdown, so the exclusion turns on intent to be read as time, not on physics. The tally stick is ruled the same way: a tally of events is the one-participant vector clock and is in; a tally of days is a clock face cut by hand and is out.
checks.form_inference: Three relations the itinerary conceals. A dependency: Half-life ledger, placed second, borrows its origin from Ratchet count, placed first, so the rate clock is not independent of the count clock. A passage between levels: One-way rite becomes Lattice of rites becomes Vector clock, a single bit becoming a partial order becoming a causal order, with the invented member sitting between two observed ones. An incompatibility: Lattice of rites and Contract calendar cannot run the same society, because rites yield no interval for a rate to multiply, and the lattice further makes priority among creditors undecidable exactly where elders are incomparable. The Milk on the step to Frozen dictionary edge adds a handoff at return, where a count of days becomes an inventory.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic (fresh context, 2026-09-07), not a self-read: the target is preserved after seven repairs, since every admitted item still names both a mechanism of retention and the inference it licenses that a clock does not (use rather than time, the moment of sealing or of uncovering, a phase gap, a deadline, an ordering with holes, a severance, a count that falls to a bound), and the repairs removed built timekeepers from the illustrations (a postmark, a dead man's switch, a Lamport tally) without domesticating any mechanism; the invented lattice keeps its strangeness.

name: passages-between-levels
of: A mechanism by which something at one level of organization arrives at another level as a different kind of thing, with a named carrier, a stated direction, what the crossing strips and supplies, and something at the far level that operates on what arrives; aggregation that changes nothing but size, breakdown that carries nothing across, and a carried shape that no taker reads are excluded.
items: Order-book alembic: private guesses become a public number when a matching engine pairs each holder's bet with a counterparty, so the price arrives one level up as something a stranger can borrow against, every reason anyone had stripped in transit; not a poll, which sums beliefs of the same kind, since a price records only the last belief someone paid for.

Backward brake light: a traffic jam travels upstream as a density wave while every car travels downstream, and it descends to each driver only as the brake light ahead, its shape, cause, and even its direction of motion lost; not “the whole constrains the part”, since this whole moves in a direction no part moves, and what the part receives is an imperative, not a description.

Prudence pooled into a stampede: each depositor's sensible withdrawal becomes a run when one shared trigger fires them together, so a solvent bank dies of an upward-arriving event that no depositor performed; the carrier is synchrony rather than a medium, nothing is integrated, and what the crossing strips is the prudence itself, sound in each and fatal in all.

Looping diagnosis: a classification made to describe people, once known by those it describes, changes how they act and describe themselves, so it descends to each person as a way of being and returns to the classifiers with altered contents; the carrier is the classified's knowledge of the class, the classification loses its independence from its objects, a new kind of person is gained; a mean that becomes “normal” is the same descent before the return trip.

Investiture: an office descends into one person so that the person's acts count as the institution's acts, a nation signing only through a hand, while the office keeps its continuity across successive bodies; the carrier is the counting-as rule fixed by oath or appointment, the direction is downward from whole to member, the acts are lost as the person's own and the whole gains the ability to act at all; unlike Looping diagnosis it changes what the acts count as, not what the holder believes.

The bow that can be withheld: a repeated gesture becomes an institution at the moment its omission becomes legible, so a handshake that was a movement becomes a slot that can be refused; the carrier is the expectation rather than the act, the crossing runs upward from body to polity, the gesture loses its innocence (it can no longer mean nothing) and gains a lever: refusal, insult, pardon; repetition alone is habit, and institution begins where absence signals.

Rule turned terrain: a local rule followed by many, drop scent where you found food, deposits into a shared medium a trail network no ant holds, so the rule arrives one level up as geography and returns to each ant as an environment it did not make; the carrier is residue accumulating in a medium, the rule loses its contingency (terrain feels like nature) and gains a memory outside any body; unlike the alembic the medium keeps a shape, not a number.

Scatter as reading: the spread of a crowd's guesses is noise to every guesser, yet to whoever holds the whole distribution its width measures how ill-posed the question was, as temperature is a census no molecule takes; not the wisdom-of-crowds mean, which is still a guess, since a width is a kind of thing no member can have, bought by losing whose guess was whose.

Dither's bargain: hiss added to an image before hard rounding turns the structured error of quantization into featureless grain, so a banded sky arrives at the level of perception as a smooth gradient; every sample is made worse so the whole can be truer, which separates it from noise reduction: the noise is the carrier, the bargain is paid per sample, and the gradient survives the cut in aggregate.

Gradient guillotined: a continuous quantity crosses into a level that can act only on verdicts and arrives as yes or no, as autoinducer concentration becomes a quorum, a fever chart a diagnosis code, a diagnosis a disability claim; upward when a colony reads its own broth, sideways when law reads medicine; degree and its uncertainty are lost, decidability is gained, and unlike dither nothing below the cut survives.

Crack to border: a fracture in rock is only damage until water takes it, deepens it into a valley, a river settles there, and a treaty names the river, each level taking the shape the one below left and adding its own kind; upward through scales, the crack is lost and a line with legal existence is gained; rubble that no water enters stays rubble, so a breakdown becomes a passage only when the next level's process uses the broken shape.

Error's promotion: a copying mistake in one B cell, wrong by the template's standard, becomes the organism's immunity when a selector one level up, antigen binding with clonal expansion, rewards its consequence and rewrites the standard around it; the error stays an error at its own level while becoming a function at the next, the template's authority is lost, a defense no cell designed is gained; without both an amplifier and a selector an error stays an error.

Baldwin's callus: a behavior practised in every generation, kneeling on hard ground, crosses from a life into a lineage when selection favors developmental programs that grow the callus before the habit does, so a habit arrives as an organ (the ostrich's callosities are the classical, contested illustration); the carrier is selection on plasticity, the choice is lost, reliability and freed learning capacity are gained; not Lamarck, since no callus is copied, only the disposition to grow one is bred for.

Grimm's law has no speaker: no speaker sets out to change their consonants, yet a language's consonants shift over centuries because each generation acquires a slightly different system and the previous one dies, so the carrier, on the acquisition account of sound change, is replacement of the members rather than change within them; upward from speakers to language, any agent of the change is lost and a law that describes a population while binding no one is gained; unlike the trail there is no medium, only succession, and where speakers drift within a lifetime the medium returns and the item no longer applies.

The fold that survives the meal: digestion destroys every level of an eaten organism above the molecule, yet a prion's conformation passes through and arrives in the eater as a rule its own proteins begin to obey; the carrier is a shape templating shapes, everything but the fold is lost, a folding rule the body never had is gained; this is the case that separates passage from breakdown: a breakdown that carries one thing across is a passage.

Smith no longer smiths: a nickname describing one person's trade becomes a surname carried by descendants who do not smith, description turning into identifier by inheritance across generations; upward from person to line, the truth of the description is lost, a line that strangers can trace is gained, and the crossing is one-way because the name keeps the word and drops the referent, so a stranger can read that someone once smithed but never who, nor whether the line still does; not a dead metaphor, which loses its image but keeps a meaning.

Drift's monument: a coin flip in one individual, a neutral mutation, becomes a character of the whole species once every alternative has been lost from the population, so that until a new mutation reopens the choice nothing can be preferred instead; the carrier is fixation, the crossing is upward and one-way because what is lost is precisely the alternatives and with them the way back, and a trait with no reason is gained; unlike Error's promotion nothing selected it, so its permanence is an absence, not a function.

Ancestor manufacture: a death becomes, through funerary and genealogical rite, a different kind of object at the level of the lineage, an ancestor who can be invoked, owed, and blamed; upward, the person (body, voice, the power to answer back) is lost and a standing claim on the living is gained; the carrier is the rite, and the crossing is one-way because the rite can only be performed on a death, which nothing on the far side can undo; not memory, which keeps the person's kind, since an ancestor is a creditor.

source.register: Mechanistic and concrete: order books, traffic waves, bank runs, dithered images, ant trails, consonant shifts, B cells, prions, surnames, funerary rites. Observed mechanisms carried by analytical distinctions; no invented-world items, the only invented setting is the wild probe.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions over observed illustrative cases. The taker criterion and the direction labels are authored; Baldwin's callus marks its classical case as contested; Ancestor manufacture and Investiture describe institutional facts, not metaphysical ones.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a physical or biological theory of levels; each item compresses an established or observed mechanism into one illustrative case, and several carriers (rite, expectation, succession) are named by the author rather than measured.

The seriation orders what a crossing does to its way back, not importance, scale, or historical order; reversibility is judged for the carrier, not for the episode (a particular bank run is not undone by desynchronizing it).

The biological items invoke established mechanisms (clonal selection, fixation by drift, genetic assimilation, prion templating) but the named cases are illustrative; the ostrich callosity is the classical and contested example of genetic assimilation and is marked as such.

“Something at the far level that operates on what arrives” is an editorial criterion induced from the nonmembers and written into the declared type on the critic's ruling, not an empirical finding; it makes membership reader-relative (a trackway no one reads is rubble with a shape; the same trackway read by a palaeontologist is a passage) and may fail for crossings where the far level is purely observational and nothing there acts.
Direction labels (up, down, sideways) presuppose an ordering of levels the fieldwork did not derive; where the ordering is contestable, as between medicine and law, the item says so.

seriation.axis: What the crossing does to the way back: from passages whose return trip runs daily in the open, through passages that return only if a reader is built on the far side, to passages whose carrier is the loss of the way back.
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scale of superiority or a ranking of irreversibility. A price that returns to its holders as a margin call before the day ends opens it; a death that becomes a creditor closes it. Dither's bargain → Gradient guillotined is the hinge: the same threshold keeps or kills what lies near it depending only on whether noise was added before the cut, which is where the way back stops being a question of who can read it and becomes a question of what the carrier destroyed; the dithered return is bounded to the noise's own width, but any way back at all is what separates the two classes. The bow that can be withheld sits before the hinge, beside Investiture, because its way back reopens whenever the polity's expectation lapses, a reader-class return, not a consumed one (moved on the critic's argument). Rule turned terrain stays in the reader-needed class although the trail returns to each ant as an environment: the rule never returns as a rule, and only a reader who holds the whole network can read the rule back out of the terrain. From the hinge each later item names a different way the carrier consumes the return: a rewritten template, a bred-in organ, dead speakers, a digested body, a forgotten referent, lost alternatives, a death.

exploration.first_question: Which mechanisms carry a thing across a level so that it arrives as a different kind, and what does each carrier strip off in transit?
exploration.changed_question: Not which crossings transform, but what on the far side takes the arriving thing: a passage exists only where a taker with different operations grips what arrives, and one-way-ness splits into two kinds, a way back that nobody on the far side can read versus a way back the carrier itself consumed. The nonmember digestion, attacked under this question, turned into a member.
exploration.new_member: The fold that survives the meal: digestion destroys every level of an eaten organism above the molecule, yet a prion's conformation passes through and arrives in the eater as a rule its own proteins begin to obey; the carrier is a shape templating shapes, everything but the fold is lost, a folding rule the body never had is gained; this is the case that separates passage from breakdown: a breakdown that carries one thing across is a passage.

priorities.item: Dither's bargain: hiss added to an image before hard rounding turns the structured error of quantization into featureless grain, so a banded sky arrives at the level of perception as a smooth gradient; every sample is made worse so the whole can be truer, which separates it from noise reduction: the noise is the carrier, the bargain is paid per sample, and the gradient survives the cut in aggregate.
priorities.why: Immediately usable and not the same as adding noise for privacy: it claims that jittering a threshold before the cut moves a crossing from the carrier-destroyed class to the reader-needed class, which is a testable property of any verdict-issuing institution.
priorities.next_question: Take one real cut score (a diagnostic cutoff, a credit limit, an exam pass mark) and simulate a small random offset applied before the cut: from the binary verdicts alone, how much of the underlying distribution can be recovered, and which institutions already do this without naming it (audit lotteries, randomized marginal admissions)? What does each individual verdict lose in exchange?

priorities.item: Ancestor manufacture: a death becomes, through funerary and genealogical rite, a different kind of object at the level of the lineage, an ancestor who can be invoked, owed, and blamed; upward, the person (body, voice, the power to answer back) is lost and a standing claim on the living is gained; the carrier is the rite, and the crossing is one-way because the rite can only be performed on a death, which nothing on the far side can undo; not memory, which keeps the person's kind, since an ancestor is a creditor.
priorities.why: Low plausibility as a practice, high generative promise: it asks whether one-way-ness is constitutive of a passage, or merely usual, by building the one crossing whose return is most unthinkable.
priorities.next_question: Invent a lineage whose funerary rite archives everything it strips, so an ancestor can be reconstituted on demand. Vary what is archived (voice, body, debts, the power to answer back) and find the smallest retained thing that un-makes the ancestor: at which point does the living owe it nothing, and is what remains a person in storage rather than an ancestor?

gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing five items (an unnamed carrier, a contradictory carrier, and three overclaims stated as fact) and two edge labels, including bounding the dither hinge's recoverability claim to the width of the noise; the taker criterion the fieldwork used was written into the declared type and the bow was moved before the hinge on the critic's seriation argument; no item cut, closest pairs tested and held.

neighbors.left: Dither's bargain: hiss added to an image before hard rounding turns the structured error of quantization into featureless grain, so a banded sky arrives at the level of perception as a smooth gradient; every sample is made worse so the whole can be truer, which separates it from noise reduction: the noise is the carrier, the bargain is paid per sample, and the gradient survives the cut in aggregate.

neighbors.separating_case: A pass/fail examination with a cut score. Guillotine: every score becomes a verdict and the cohort's distribution of ability below the cut is gone from the verdicts. Dither: add a small random offset to each score before applying the same cut; every verdict is still binary and each is slightly less fair, but grouped pass rates now recover the density of scores within the offset's width of the cut, which is exactly the count of marginal cases a cut-score institution most needs, while everyone far below the cut still fails every time and stays unread. Same threshold, same binary output; noise before the cut is the only difference, and it decides whether any way back exists, though what comes back is only the region near the cut.

checks.boundary_case: Which side of the road a country drives on is tempting: an arbitrary individual choice becomes a population fact that no one can undo. It is out because nothing arrives transformed: a side of the road is the same kind of thing for one driver and for all of them, and its irreversibility is a coordination cost, not a stripped way back. Aggregation with a lock is still aggregation, as a heap is still sand.
checks.form_inference: Loop and re-entry. The alembic → brake light → stampede → alembic cycle descends and then re-ascends, so the third item feeds the first from one level up; a line shows three neighbors and hides the return. Drift's monument → Error's promotion is a re-entry across the selector fork: what the seriation places far apart, a functionless fixation and a selected function, are one late selector apart. Dither × Guillotine is an incompatibility at a single threshold, which adjacency can only hint at; the edge states what an institution must do about it.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context (2026-09-07), not a self-read: the closest pairs (brake light with stampede, alembic with scatter, terrain with crack, Smith with ancestor) were attacked and could not be collapsed, and every repair bounded an overclaim or named a missing carrier without replacing a strange mechanism (a fold crossing a meal, a law carried by pure succession, a wave that moves against its members) with a more respectable one.

name: forms-of-return
of: A mechanism by which something comes back to a place, state, person, or practice across an absence, distinguished by where the sameness that licenses the return is kept and by what the return does with the interval it crosses.
items: Silent gene: a trait returns after generations of absence because its code was kept unexpressed, as when a whale is born with hind limbs; what returns was never absent, only silent, which separates it from convergence, where the trait is rebuilt from nothing.

Natal stream: a salmon homes on the smell of the water it hatched in and, arriving, spawns and dies, so the one who is home afterward is offspring who never departed and the returner is spent by its own arrival; a homing that leaves the returner alive to be boxed and flown out again is Pigeon in a box, not this.

Carriage return: the typewriter carriage goes back to the left margin while the platen advances one line, so the next stroke lands on the same column of a row that did not exist before; one coordinate is exactly regained and the other is irreversibly advanced, so no point is ever revisited, which separates it from any cycle.

Halley's appointment: the comet returns to the same sky every seventy-six years, about one life, so the return is kept as a prediction handed to successors who never saw the last passage, as Halley named a return he could not live to see; a return kept by a witness who saw it before, as a season is, is not this, even when a rare witness lives to see the comet twice.

Reentry burn: the road back is the road out crossed at a different speed, so a capsule that rose gently through the atmosphere must shed its whole orbital energy as heat coming down; the road is open and hostile in one direction only, which is not the same as a road that has closed.

Stack unwind: a recursive call returns through every frame it passed, in reverse order, and each frame adds its share so that the answer exists only on the way back; a return that skips frames, as a thrown exception does, arrives with no answer, so it is an escape, not a shortcut.

Pigeon in a box: a homing pigeon carried away in a closed box returns without any record of the outward road, so the return is navigated, not retraced, from a field that spans both places and a remembered value of home within it (how pigeons do this is still contested); it fails wherever the field does not reach, not wherever the road was long.

Writ returned: a sheriff returns the writ to the court endorsed with what was done, and a tax return renders an account of the year, so the document comes back inscribed with its own interval; a thing that comes back unmarked is a refund, not a return of this kind.

Hard reset: restoring a backup returns a file to its past state and deletes whatever grew in the interval, as git reset --hard does where git revert would return the content while keeping the interval as history; this return counts by pretending the absence never happened.

Open-box refund: the buyer returns the item and receives the full price while the item goes back on the shelf marked open-box at a discount; fungible value returns whole and the particular returns marked, so the cost of the interval is priced onto the thing, where a restocking fee would price it onto the money instead.

Reconsolidation: recalling a memory makes it labile and re-stores it altered, so each return to a memory rewrites it and the most revisited memories are the least original (a laboratory finding whose scope is still contested); this is not forgetting, since the memory returns vivid and changed.

Reprise: the theme returns note for note after a contrasting section, as a rondo refrain does, and sounds like a homecoming only because the hearer has been away; the notes are unchanged and the hearer is not, which separates it from reconsolidation, where the notes drift and the hearer feels no change.

Scar in the washbasin: the returner is unrecognizable except by one old mark and one witness who remembers it, as Odysseus is known by his dog and by the nurse who finds the scar while washing his feet; sameness lives in the recognizer, so the return cannot be asserted, only received, and it dies with the last witness.

Reunion pageant: at a class reunion the place performs its former self for the returners and the returners perform their former selves for each other, on a set date, with a script, so sameness is manufactured at arrival by coordinated pretense; a return that finds its sameness ready-made, as a reprise does, needs no pageant, and a pageant with no returners is a festival.

Restitution to a descendant: the Benin bronzes return to a Nigeria in which the palace they were taken from was burned and the kingdom is a state within a state, so the return must nominate who receives them; not a refund, since nothing equivalent is substituted, and not a return to a place, since the place has to be chosen.

Agamemnon's bath: the returner's slot was kept open as king and husband and the household filled that slot with a plan, so the return delivers him to the trap the absence built; the place changed because of the absence, not merely during it.

Return to sender: a letter comes back stamped addressee unknown, so the return is a verdict that the addressee and the address came apart during the interval, learned only because the envelope could not stay; not a bounce from a closed road, where the destination may still be there and reachable later.

Regression to the mean: a slumping player returns to form and nothing returned, because the slump was noise and the average reasserted itself; a relapse into a conserved basin is told from this by whether any intervention could have held, since here there was nothing to hold.

source.register: Mechanistic and concrete: whales, salmon, typewriters, comets, capsules, call stacks, pigeons, writs, backups, refunds, reunions, bronzes, envelopes; two literary cases used as mechanisms.
source.mode: A clearly separated mixture: observed physical, biological, legal, computational, and musical mechanisms read analytically; Reconsolidation and Pigeon in a box rest on contested laboratory literatures and are marked as such; no invented-world members.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an exhaustive typology; one actual return may run several of these mechanisms at once, as a restitution can also be a reunion pageant.
The seriation orders where the licensing sameness is kept and what the return does with its interval, not value, difficulty, or historical order; edges are conditional authored claims.

Reconsolidation and Pigeon in a box are used for the shape of their mechanisms on the strength of contested laboratory literatures (memory reconsolidation; the gradient-map account of pigeon homing); neither item claims the science is settled.
Literary cases (Odysseus, Agamemnon) stand in for mechanisms that recur; the map does not claim they are the origin or best instance of those mechanisms.
The sonar seed, in which the return's delay measures the road it crossed, is left outside because it turned the list toward instruments; it is recorded as the best unresolved seed.

seriation.axis: Where the sameness that licenses the return is kept, and what the return does with the interval: from sameness stored silently in the returner's own code, through the geometry of the cycle and the road, through an external record the return may file or erase, through sameness that others must supply at arrival, to sameness supplied by nothing.
seriation.note: An itinerary, not a scale: Silent gene opens it with sameness kept in the returner's unexpressed code, and Regression to the mean closes it with a return that conserves nothing but the distribution. Writ returned to Hard reset is the hinge: both return a record, and the adjacency shows that a return by record must decide whether the absence is part of the record; git's revert and reset are that decision made twice, in opposite directions. Scar in the washbasin sits at the seam between record-kept and witness-kept sameness: the mark is kept in the returner's body but licensed only by a reader, so the itinerary walks from Reprise, where sameness is ready-made, through recognition received, into Reunion pageant, where recognition is performed; the Scar to Reunion pageant edge claims that passage (placement argued by the Fable critic).

relations.from: Stack unwind: a recursive call returns through every frame it passed, in reverse order, and each frame adds its share so that the answer exists only on the way back; a return that skips frames, as a thrown exception does, arrives with no answer, so it is an escape, not a shortcut.
relations.to: Pigeon in a box: a homing pigeon carried away in a closed box returns without any record of the outward road, so the return is navigated, not retraced, from a field that spans both places and a remembered value of home within it (how pigeons do this is still contested); it fails wherever the field does not reach, not wherever the road was long.
relations.label: If the outward road was never recorded, retracing is unavailable and the return must be computed from the destination alone; the fork is decided by what was kept during departure, not by how far one went.

relations.from: Writ returned: a sheriff returns the writ to the court endorsed with what was done, and a tax return renders an account of the year, so the document comes back inscribed with its own interval; a thing that comes back unmarked is a refund, not a return of this kind.
relations.to: Hard reset: restoring a backup returns a file to its past state and deletes whatever grew in the interval, as git reset --hard does where git revert would return the content while keeping the interval as history; this return counts by pretending the absence never happened.
relations.label: If the return must leave the place exactly as it was in history as well as in content, the endorsement cannot be kept and filing becomes erasing; git revert shows the compromise, exact in content while the history still shows the trip.

relations.from: Natal stream: a salmon homes on the smell of the water it hatched in and, arriving, spawns and dies, so the one who is home afterward is offspring who never departed and the returner is spent by its own arrival; a homing that leaves the returner alive to be boxed and flown out again is Pigeon in a box, not this.
relations.to: Restitution to a descendant: the Benin bronzes return to a Nigeria in which the palace they were taken from was burned and the kingdom is a state within a state, so the return must nominate who receives them; not a refund, since nothing equivalent is substituted, and not a return to a place, since the place has to be chosen.
relations.label: If either end of the return does not survive the interval as an individual, the salmon spent at arrival or the palace burned before the bronzes came back, the return passes from an individual to a lineage and must nominate who stands at that end.

relations.from: Halley's appointment: the comet returns to the same sky every seventy-six years, about one life, so the return is kept as a prediction handed to successors who never saw the last passage, as Halley named a return he could not live to see; a return kept by a witness who saw it before, as a season is, is not this, even when a rare witness lives to see the comet twice.
relations.to: Reprise: the theme returns note for note after a contrasting section, as a rondo refrain does, and sounds like a homecoming only because the hearer has been away; the notes are unchanged and the hearer is not, which separates it from reconsolidation, where the notes drift and the hearer feels no change.
relations.label: If the period approaches a life, one return splits its audience: the rare witness of both passages hears a reprise while everyone else receives an appointment; past a life, only the appointment remains, since a reprise needs the same hearer on both sides of the absence.

exploration.first_question: What has to be conserved across an absence for a return to count as a return at all, and what carries that conservation: the returner's body, the road, a record, or a witness?
exploration.changed_question: Once several plausible returns turned out to conserve nothing (regression to the mean, the returned letter), the question moved from what survives the absence to what the return does with the absence: erases it, files it, rewrites it, performs it away, or announces it.

priorities.item: Reconsolidation: recalling a memory makes it labile and re-stores it altered, so each return to a memory rewrites it and the most revisited memories are the least original (a laboratory finding whose scope is still contested); this is not forgetting, since the memory returns vivid and changed.
priorities.why: Cheap to probe and immediately consequential: if the return itself is the rewriting mechanism, then every homecoming account is evidence about the returner, not the place, and the loop with Reunion pageant becomes testable.
priorities.next_question: Before leaving a place, write a page describing it and seal it. On return, write the recalled page before rereading the sealed one, then diff them. Which differences are drift from the interval and which appear only after the return has begun?

priorities.item: Halley's appointment: the comet returns to the same sky every seventy-six years, about one life, so the return is kept as a prediction handed to successors who never saw the last passage, as Halley named a return he could not live to see; a return kept by a witness who saw it before, as a season is, is not this, even when a rare witness lives to see the comet twice.
priorities.why: Low readiness, high generative promise: a return whose period exceeds any life must be held as an appointment by people who never saw the departure, which makes recognition an institutional design problem rather than a memory.
priorities.next_question: Invent a return with a three-hundred-year period. What must its keepers conserve so that the arrival is received as a return and not as a discovery? Test at small scale with a time capsule opened by strangers: what single note lets them tell a return from a find?

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing nine clauses that stated absolutes or contested mechanisms their own cases falsify, relabeling three edges whose antecedents failed on the items they pointed at, and moving Scar in the washbasin beside Reunion pageant where the axis places it; no item cut, no neighbor pair collapsed.

neighbors.left: Reconsolidation: recalling a memory makes it labile and re-stores it altered, so each return to a memory rewrites it and the most revisited memories are the least original (a laboratory finding whose scope is still contested); this is not forgetting, since the memory returns vivid and changed.

neighbors.separating_case: Play a recording of a melody twice: the second hearing is a reprise, bitwise identical, moving because of what the hearer did between plays. Hum the melody from memory twice: the second humming drifts from the first, and the hummer feels no change. The recording separates the two because it cannot reconsolidate.

checks.boundary_case: Deja vu is a felt return with no departure, so there is no interval whose conservation could be tested and nothing for the return to do with an absence; it belongs to a list of false-recognition mechanisms, not here.
checks.form_inference: The map forks Stack unwind from Pigeon in a box on whether the outward road was recorded, a fact fixed at departure that a sequence cannot show. It closes a loop between Reconsolidation and Reunion pageant: private recall rewrites what the reunion performs, and the performance is re-stored as recall, so the two cannot be ordered. It passes between levels at Natal stream to Restitution to a descendant, where the returning individual is replaced by a lineage that must nominate its recipient.
checks.target_preserved: Independent judgment of the Fable critic (fresh context, 2026-09-07): the mechanisms are real, no item collapses into its neighbor, and the Reconsolidation to Reunion pageant loop survived attack; the strange members (a return completed by heirs, a return that is a verdict that name and address came apart, a return with nothing behind it) stay strange after repair, and each repair fixed a clause its own case falsified rather than replacing a mechanism.

name: what-a-price-does
of: Mechanisms by which a price accomplishes something other than clearing a market, each named with what the price does, the carrier through which it does it, and what the clearing story misses, including prices that work by their bare existence and prices that work by never being paid.
items: Velvet rope: a price set high enough that the crowd it admits becomes the product for everyone in it, as the nine-dollar coffee keeps the coworking floor quiet by pricing out anyone who came to sit for an afternoon, and the private bank's minimum balance sells its other clients' company; the carrier is the buyer population, the seller wants fewer buyers of a particular sort, and the quantity a clearing price would sell is the failure rather than the goal.

Price as testimony: where quality cannot be shown before purchase, a high price is the one claim a low-quality seller could not afford to keep making, as the consultant with no credential charges what the credentialed charge and the unknown wine sells at the price of the known; the carrier is the buyer's inference, it works only where repeat purchase exists since a one-shot fraud can charge anything once, and the clearing story reads demand rising with the price as an error. Contested: signaling, status display, and placebo-quality effects are hard to separate in the observed cases.

Go-away price: a bid padded past any number the seller expects to win, so an unwanted counterparty is refused without a refusal and the door stays open for the next job, as the roofer who dislikes the client quotes triple and the fisherman names a price for the tourist's charter he hopes never to run; unlike the rope, which thins a population in advance, this refuses one counterparty after seeing them, and it forks on acceptance, since a go-away price that is paid becomes an obligation at a number that was meant as compensation for reluctance.

Tier that makes the kind: a price band constitutes a category that did not exist before the number, so goods are compared only within the band and judged by the band's standards, as the third-class carriage made a class of passenger out of a fare, and a two-thousand-dollar bicycle is reviewed by different magazines than a two-hundred-dollar one from the same factory; the carrier is the catalog or the shelf, the price sits upstream of the good's identity rather than downstream of its quality, and unlike testimony it makes no claim, it makes a room.

Price for the stranger's eyes: a price set for a reader who is not party to the trade, because each recorded price is evidence in the next one, as the gallery bids on its own artist at auction so the record will not print a low number, the recorded house sale sets the neighbor's assessment, and the transfer price between two subsidiaries is addressed to the tax authority alone; the carrier is the public record, and the clearing story cannot explain a seller who refuses cash to protect a number. Exchange-ontologies lists Precedent as a good that can be traded; this is the mechanism by which an ordinary price takes a second job as precedent whether the parties want it or not.

Six-minute increment: the shape of a price teaches the buyer what the thing is for, as the lawyer's tenth-of-an-hour billing teaches the client not to call, the cloud's outbound-data fee teaches the customer that data stays put, and the free tier with a rate limit teaches the developer that this is a toy; the carrier is the meter, the instruction rides on the unit and the step rather than the number, and the clearing story treats the buyer's use as given when the price wrote it.

Fixed price, thin walls: the shape of a price decides which of the seller's own temptations is live, as the fixed-price build tempts the builder to thin the walls, time-and-materials tempts them to slow down, and capitation tempts the clinic to prefer the healthy; the carrier is the seller's margin at the margin, it mirrors the six-minute increment since here the meter instructs the seller, and the clearing story holds the seller's effort constant while the price is varying it.

Quote that cannot be compared: a price built in a unit, bundle, or bespoke form no rival quotes in, so the buyer cannot perform the comparison a market needs, as the mobile plan whose every term differs from every other plan's, the hospital's bundled bill, and 'price on application'; the carrier is the form of the quote, it reverses the tier since it dissolves the class the tier made, and the clearing story assumes a market that this price was built to prevent. The reverse rule, mandatory unit pricing on the shelf, makes a market by an order about the price's form rather than its level.

Price that names the wrong payer: the price the buyer sees is set to produce a payment somewhere else, and that other payment, not the visible one, is what the seller designs for, so the buyer cannot see whose interest the seller serves, as the free checking account built to produce overdraft fees, the free search paid by the advertiser who is the actual customer, and the prison phone call priced high because the jailer who awarded the contract takes a commission from every minute; the carrier is the bundle or the tie, it is not a price merely collected later, since a net-thirty invoice is still the price the seller designs for, and the clearing story reads each price alone when the pair is the instrument.

Price that goes to sleep: a price chosen once and then paid by inertia, so its work is done at the moment of first acceptance and never again, as the subscription that renews and the default tip the screen suggests; the carrier is the auto-renewal, the seller optimizes the first sight rather than the recurring value, and the market never clears again after the first purchase. Leverage-discoveries lists the default as a lever; this is the price's own mechanism, which is to stop being seen.

Mates' rates: a price below market whose number is a statement of relation, which the buyer must not haggle over and must repay in kind, as the plumber's rate to a friend, the wholesale price extended to a cousin, and the guest-friend's token payment that says this is not a purchase; the carrier is the discount read as speech, it reverses the invoice since here a price keeps a trade inside a relation rather than ending one, and the clearing story sees a seller leaving money on the table.

Invoice that ends the favor: attaching a price to something that was given moves it out of the gift register, where obligation and shame keep it flowing, into the market register, where it is merely for sale, and the move does not reverse when the price is removed, as the daycare that fined late parents saw lateness rise, because a fine is a price for an option that shame had kept closed, and lateness stayed high after the fine was dropped; the carrier is the invoice, the price works by changing the kind of relation rather than the quantity traded, and the clearing story predicts the opposite sign. The one-way move rests on a small number of field studies and is contested; the mechanism is kept with that modality.

Peppercorn: the existence of any price at all, however small, moves a transfer into the register a court can see, as the peppercorn rent makes a lease enforceable and the one-dollar sale gives a gift a buyer, a date, and a warranty to sue on; the carrier is the contract, the magnitude is irrelevant to a witness that reads only whether a price exists and useless against one that reads how much, since the tax office and the assessor look through a dollar sale to the gift beneath it, and the clearing story has no place for a price whose entire work is done by being nonzero.

Deposit that comes back: a price returned if the buyer does what they said, so it rations requests by putting money at risk rather than by collecting it, as the restaurant deposit refunded on arrival, earnest money on a house, and bail; the carrier is escrow, the net price is zero for everyone who keeps their word, and the clearing story cannot see a price that changes hands twice and ends where it began. It also earns the seller float, which is the one number in it a spreadsheet will find.

Fee that holds the door: a price the seller hopes never to collect, as the cancellation fee, the late fee, and the liquidated-damages clause, which work by being believed and stop working when they are paid often, since a fee collected often enough to be optimized as revenue becomes a rack rate for lateness and the door it held swings open; the carrier is the threat, nothing changes hands on the good path where the deposit changes hands twice, and the clearing story sees a fee that is never paid as a price with no demand.

Decoy that must not sell: an item priced so that its neighbor looks right, whose job is done by being declined and needs no sale, as the four-hundred-dollar bottle on the wine list exists to make the ninety-dollar bottle the sensible choice and the largest popcorn exists to sell the middle one; the carrier is the menu, the unpaid number belongs to a neighboring good rather than to the good it sells, and the clearing story calls an unsold item a mispricing when it is the one item doing its job. Adjacent to first-mover-forecloses' anchoring of a price expectation, which is about who sets the scale first; this is about a price that works by being declined.

Rack rate: a list price nobody pays, kept so that every real price can be a discount from it, granted selectively and felt as a favor, and so that a third party can be billed against it, as the hotel's posted rate and the hospital chargemaster that only the uninsured and the insurer's formula ever meet; the carrier is the discount, the price is for the very good on sale yet clears nothing for anyone, and removing it does not lower prices but removes the seller's power to give.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: cover charges, padded bids, wine lists, chargemasters, peppercorn rents, daycare fines, tenth-of-an-hour billing, earnest money, cancellation fees, prison phone calls; drawn from restaurants, construction, law, medicine, banking, hotels, software, auctions, and rail.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism; two items (Price as testimony, Invoice that ends the favor) rest on contested field evidence and say so in the item; no item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an empirical taxonomy or a partition; a real price usually does several of these at once (a rack rate is also a price for the stranger's eyes; a deposit also rations attention), and the list makes no claim to cover every job a price can hold.

The seriation is an itinerary by which feature of the price carries the work (magnitude, shape, existence, non-collection), not a ranking of importance, frequency, or profit; map edges are conditional authored claims, and the loop through the late fee is one reading of one industry's history.

The illustrative cases (the daycare fine, the video-store late fee, the chargemaster, the peppercorn rent, the gallery buying back its own artist, the prison phone contract, the third-class carriage, whose 1844 statute fixed fare and minimum accommodation together so that fare and carriage co-defined the class) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories; the field evidence behind Invoice that ends the favor and Price as testimony is contested.

Prices that clear across time or across segments (surge pricing, early-bird tickets, a discount behind an identity fence) are deliberately outside: they are clearing with the date or the wall moved, and the number does its ordinary work.
Zero-price goods and gift economies are outside except where a nominal price crosses the line in or out (Peppercorn, Invoice that ends the favor, Mates' rates).

seriation.axis: Which feature of the price carries the work: its magnitude (raise it and fewer come), its shape (the unit, the step, the bundle), its bare existence (nonzero is the whole instrument), or its non-collection (a number kept on the books and taken from no one), with the same endpoints: Velvet rope, where the magnitude is the whole instrument, and Rack rate, where the number is collected from no one.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of sophistication or a history. Velvet rope opens it because there the number is the entire mechanism; Rack rate closes it because there the number is paid by no one and exists only to make other numbers. The middle passes from magnitude (testimony, go-away, tier, the stranger's record) to shape (increment, thin walls, the incomparable quote, the wrong payer, the sleeping default) to existence (mates' rates, the invoice, the peppercorn) to non-collection (deposit, door fee, decoy, rack rate). The axis was renamed on the critic's showing that 'how much of the work the number itself does' fails for the last four stations: the deposit rations by its size, the door fee threatens by its size, and the decoy and the rack rate work by being high, so 'magnitude irrelevant' is true of the peppercorn alone and the far end is not 'the number does nothing' but 'the number is never collected'; no station moved. The consequential adjacency is Invoice that ends the favor → Peppercorn: the same nonzero number that ends a favor makes a contract, because leaving the gift register and entering the legal register are one move seen from two sides, and both are one-way; an operator who invoices a friend to 'make it official' has done both at once, and the repaired Peppercorn makes the adjacency teach more, since the court reads existence, the tax office reads magnitude, and the friends read neither. The hinge is Deposit that comes back → Fee that holds the door, where the price stops changing hands on the good path and becomes pure threat, and the door fee's own failure (being collected) sends it back up the itinerary to Rack rate.

relations.label: If the user is not the payer, there is no bill to wake them, so the price sleeps as long as the real payer is content; free is the deepest sleep, and it is broken only from the payer's side.

relations.from: Fee that holds the door: a price the seller hopes never to collect, as the cancellation fee, the late fee, and the liquidated-damages clause, which work by being believed and stop working when they are paid often, since a fee collected often enough to be optimized as revenue becomes a rack rate for lateness and the door it held swings open; the carrier is the threat, nothing changes hands on the good path where the deposit changes hands twice, and the clearing story sees a fee that is never paid as a price with no demand.
relations.to: Invoice that ends the favor: attaching a price to something that was given moves it out of the gift register, where obligation and shame keep it flowing, into the market register, where it is merely for sale, and the move does not reverse when the price is removed, as the daycare that fined late parents saw lateness rise, because a fine is a price for an option that shame had kept closed, and lateness stayed high after the fine was dropped; the carrier is the invoice, the price works by changing the kind of relation rather than the quantity traded, and the clearing story predicts the opposite sign. The one-way move rests on a small number of field studies and is contested; the mechanism is kept with that modality.
relations.label: If the fee is collected often enough to appear on the income statement, it is optimized as revenue, and a threat that is priced becomes the price of an option: the buyer who once felt they should not cancel now knows what cancelling costs, which is the daycare's move made by the seller.
