priorities.item: Twenty in the till: one party stages a windfall the other could keep without being caught, as a bar owner leaves a loose twenty in the drawer on a new bartender's first shift or a jeweler overpays a courier by one stone; the carrier is an apparent error, the first move is safe because the stake is small and its return is uncoerced information, and the residue is that the probe must stay secret forever, since a cooperation later found to have begun as a test reads as contempt; not a gift, which announces itself and makes a debt rather than a reading.
priorities.why: It is the smallest ignition and the only one whose residue is entirely a secret, so it can be varied on paper; it also turned out to be the form every staged circumstance takes, which makes it the key to the live question of what one side can light alone.
priorities.next_question: With a fictional roster of twenty new hires, vary the planted windfall from a coin to a week's wage and vary the chance the hire later learns it was a test; find the size below which its return says nothing about the hire, and the disclosure probability above which the probe costs more cooperation than it buys.

priorities.item: Beach with no faces: the exchange is arranged so that no step requires trusting the next, as in the reported silent trade where traders laid goods on the shore and withdrew, the other side laid gold beside them and withdrew, and the first party took the gold or left it if the pile was short; the carrier is a spatial protocol in which every move is retractable until the last, the first move is safe because at no moment does either party hold both goods, and the residue is that no channel exists, so the parties cannot complain, explain, bundle, or extend credit, and the cooperation cannot grow past spot exchange; Herodotus's account is disputed as history and is kept for the mechanism, which the atomic swap reproduces exactly, each side's transfer locked until the other's is revealed and either side free to walk until the last step; the escrowed darknet sale does not, since its market is a holder with a face, and a cash sale across a counter has the protocol without the residue, since the faces leave a channel and the beach's ceiling is bought by their absence, not by the protocol.
priorities.why: Low plausibility as history and high generative promise as a design: it is the only ignition that needs no trust at any step, and its residue, no channel, names exactly what every richer cooperation must add and therefore where trust must begin.
priorities.next_question: Write one modern deal between strangers as a silent trade, every step retractable until the last and no channel, for instance a data-for-compute swap between two firms; then add features one at a time (a complaint, a bundle, thirty days' credit) and record the first feature that cannot be added without a face, since that feature marks where the retractable protocol ends and some other ignition on this map must take over.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing the type's no-enforcer clause to the criterion the author actually applied, removing a false exclusivity from the divisibility fork, relabeling the staged-circumstance passage so a manipulation is not called a probe, and repairing seven items whose illustrative cases or attributions did not carry their own mechanism.

neighbors.left: Hostage before the ask: one party hands over, unrequested, something the other can destroy but not use, as a demolition subcontractor parks its excavator on the owner's lot the night before any contract is signed, or a touring band leaves its backline in the club's cellar before the settlement is agreed; the carrier is the hostage asymmetry Williamson called the ugly princess, precious to the giver and worth little to the holder, so that holding it tempts no one to provoke a default, the first move is safe because it costs nothing if the other cooperates and says what words cannot, and the residue is that the holder keeps a permanent option to destroy and the cooperation cannot grow past the hostage's value without a second hostage; not collateral demanded, which is a term, not source escrow or a bond, where a third party holds the thing and the counterpart gains its use on release, and not cooperation-mechanisms' retained hostages, which steady a cooperation already running; here the unasked giving is the whole signal.
neighbors.right: First cut: one party destroys its own outside option in the other's sight, as a tailor cuts the bolt to the stranger's measurements before a deposit is paid or a machine shop tools a die for one customer's part; the carrier is a good made specific to one counterpart and so unsaleable to any other, the first move is safe because the cut is cheap against the job and the customer now knows the tailor cannot walk, and the residue is bilateral monopoly, since the customer can no longer get this coat elsewhere either, so the second negotiation is a hold-up; not a hostage, which is handed to someone, since after the cut nobody holds anything and the loss is simply made.
neighbors.separating_case: A demolition subcontractor's excavator parked on the owner's lot before any contract against a tailor's bolt cut to a stranger's measurements: the owner holds a machine it can damage or detain but has no use for, gains a one-way option to destroy, and the cooperation's ceiling is the machine's value, while only the subcontractor is bound; after the cut nobody holds anything, the tailor's outside option is simply gone, and the customer's has died with it, since the coat now exists nowhere else. The hostage leaves a one-way option; the cut leaves a hold-up in both directions, which is why the residues differ and the two cannot be merged. The critic's own test took the map's load-bearing pair, Twenty in the till against Lot you can lose, and separated them on what the mover can read (unperformed against performed conduct) and on what it can do next (never mention it against climb a rung).

checks.boundary_case: A bank's letter of credit between an exporter and an importer who have never met is out: it looks like the cleanest ignition, but the two parties never cooperate with each other at all, since each transacts with the bank, and they may finish the deal still strangers; it substitutes for cooperation rather than igniting it. Broker of both names is in on exactly that contrast, since the broker lends a name the parties must then honor to each other. A court-enforced contract is out only when the contract itself is what makes the first move safe, since many members (the earn-out, the sharecrop, the license) have a court behind the paper without asking either stranger to be trusted. Cash across a flea-market table, the critic's tempting nonmember, is out as a separate member and out of the Beach as written, since its faces leave a channel and the cooperation can grow past spot exchange.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals: from Lot you can lose two branches leave on the question of divisibility, to Hostage before the ask when a thing already made can be handed over, and to Price after the crop when the good can be waited for; the branches are not exclusive, since a merger with an escrow holdback and an earn-out takes both, so the fork is on what exists to be given now. It shows a re-ignition, a passage from Promise that costs nothing yet to Lot you can lose at the first claim, where a free promise only defers the ladder, so the mutual ignites twice; one back-edge is not a loop, since nothing returns from the lot to the pool. It shows an incompatibility between two items that sit apart on the itinerary, Sin in common and Summoned witness, since a cooperation welded to a secret cannot add a public witness without confessing. It shows a passage between levels at Enemy at both doors → Twenty in the till, where any circumstance at the far end of the itinerary, staged by one side, drops to the near end and inherits the probe's secret as its residue without itself being a probe, since it seeks the cooperation and not a reading, which is the map's answer to which ignitions one side can light. And it shows a second passage at Peace of the fair → Broker of both names, where a recurring truce's host becomes a broker and the fair's toll becomes the broker's permanent cut.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context, who tried to collapse the map's load-bearing pair (Twenty in the till against Lot you can lose) and could not, ruled a flea-market cash sale out of the Beach on its faces, and found that the strange members (a planted twenty, a shore with no faces, a sin as first act, a promise free until the barn burns, a tailor's cut) survive as mechanisms; the repairs fell on the type's no-enforcer clause, on illustrative cases and one attribution that did not carry their own item, on a false exclusivity at the fork, and on one edge label, and no item was cut or softened into advice.

name: clean-exits
of: A mechanism by which a party leaves a partnership, deal, market, or cooperation while something named survives the leaving that the default exit would have destroyed, stated with what is conserved, who pays for the leaving, and what the exit makes legible to the next entrant, and sorted by where its terms were fixed: at entry before anyone knew who would leave, by the trade before the deal existed, by a third party at the door, or by the known parties at the door.
items: Shotgun at the table: at deadlock either partner names a single price and the other must choose to buy or sell at it, so the namer prices honestly because they do not yet know which side of the trade they will stand on, as in the buy-sell clauses of two-person contracting firms; conserved is the business whole under one owner and a price nobody argued, the cost falls on the partner who cannot fund the buy, who sells at whatever the richer one names, and the next entrant learns to compare purses before signing; not a formula, since the price is discovered by the leaving itself, and it cannot be improvised because the partner with the smaller purse, once purses are known, refuses a game whose only move for them is to sell.

Price fixed behind the veil: the exit price is a formula written at entry, book value or a multiple of trailing billings, as accounting partnerships and farm cooperatives pay a departing member out at par; conserved is the going concern and the relationship, since nothing is argued on the day, the cost falls on whoever the formula underpays, usually the leaver, who forfeits the goodwill they built, and the next entrant learns that goodwill made here stays here; not the shotgun, since nothing is discovered, and it works only because both signed before either knew which side they would be on, so after the quarrel no formula can be agreed.

Fade by formula: the partner who stops answering capital calls is not expelled but diluted on a schedule fixed at entry, as a venture syndicate's pay-to-play terms convert a non-participant's preferred shares to common at each round they sit out; conserved is the venture and the room, since nobody is thrown out and what the fader leaves is the syndicate's calls and its preference while their common stays on the cap table, the cost falls on the fader in slices with no single day to contest, and the next entrant learns that exit here is a slope, not a step; not a vesting cliff, which makes leaving a date around which the roster clusters at month thirteen, and not expulsion, since the fader may stop fading at any call.

Drag and tag: when the majority sells, the minority must sell with it (drag) or may sell with it (tag) at the same price, so one party's exit becomes everyone's on identical terms; conserved is a buyer who gets the whole and a minority that gets the majority's price, the cost is the minority's veto and the majority's freedom to sell alone, and the next entrant learns at signing whether their exit will be theirs or someone else's; cannot be improvised, since a minority not dragged at entry holds up the sale at exit, and distinct from the shotgun because the price is set by a stranger, not by a partner.

Queue at the door: exits are paced so that leaving does not force the sale that would hurt those who stay, as a fund redeems quarterly on ninety days' notice with a gate at a tenth of assets, and an executive's notice period holds the seat for a fixed term whether or not a successor has been found; conserved is the stayers' value, the cost falls on the leaver in time, and the next entrant reads the queue's length as the printed illiquidity of what they are buying into; time, not money, and a gate the leaver signed at entry is read as the terms while a gate imposed by amendment on the day is read as a default, offered as the reading of why some 2008 gates kept their investors and others lost them.

Swing price: the leaver's exit price is adjusted by the trading cost their leaving imposes on the stayers, so a redemption on a bad day is paid out at a value reduced by an estimate of what it cost the fund to raise the cash, applied once net outflows cross a threshold; conserved is the stayers' value, as nearly as the estimate is right, the cost falls on the leaver in the amount of their own haste, and the next entrant learns that an exit has a price and it is printed on the confirm; money, not time, so a queue defers the harm while a swing charges it, and unlike an exit fee the amount is not fixed but measured on the day.

Fork that keeps the commons: the leaver copies the whole codebase and leaves the name, as MariaDB left MySQL and LibreOffice left OpenOffice; conserved is the code for both parties and the name for the stayer, the cost is a split community and two crews maintaining one lineage, borne by everyone who depended on it, and the next entrant learns that the license chosen at entry fixed the exit, since proprietary code cannot be forked; copy rather than subtraction, and it is the trademark, not the license, that decides who keeps the name.

Name stays on the door: the founder retires and the firm keeps their name, as law firms are named for partners dead a century; conserved is the reputational asset detached from the person, the cost falls on the leaver, who loses control of what their name is now used to do, and on the stayers, who inherit every scandal the name will be attached to, and the next entrant learns that the name became the firm's on the day the shingle went up in firm form; the reverse of the curtain, since the name stays and the person goes, and it was designed at entry by the choice of what to paint on the glass.

Everyone leaves at once: the venture is chartered to end on a date or an event, as a film production company dissolves after the picture and a joint venture formed to build one bridge is wound up at the ribbon, so no one is ever the leaver; conserved is the relationship among the parties and a set of accounts closed and paid, the cost is compounding forfeited and the venture re-formed each time, and the next entrant learns they are entering a term, not a marriage; not a party's exit but the abolition of leaving, and unlike a notice period it ends the thing rather than the membership.

Dividing the curtain: a long-serving employee leaves to open their own shop under the master's name with the master's blessing and no fee, the noren-wake of Japanese restaurants and shops; conserved is the name, now in two places, and the master's standing, which grows with each shop bearing it, the cost falls on the master, who loses the hands and takes any disgrace the second shop earns, and the next entrant learns that years served are the price of the name; not a franchise, since no fee flows and no contract binds, and not the fork, since the name is shared rather than kept by the stayer.

Sell the seat, not the house: the leaver's place is sold to a substitute the stayers accept, as a limited partner sells its fund interest on the secondary market, a tenant assigns a lease, a member sells an exchange seat; conserved is the venture untouched and a seat never empty, the cost falls on the leaver in the discount a stranger demands and on the stayers in the consent they must give, and the next entrant learns whether a market for their seat exists, which is a property of the trade, not of the deal; substitution rather than subtraction or copy, and the leaver is not gone but replaced.

Reinsurance to close: after three years a Lloyd's syndicate year pays a premium to a later year to take over every liability still open, and the members of the closed year walk free of it forever; conserved is a home for every liability and a leaver who is truly out, the cost falls on the leaver, who pays the stayers to hold the tail, and the next entrant learns that the price of leaving a long-tailed promise is the price of the tail, and that when the tail cannot be priced, as asbestos could not, the year stays open and nobody leaves; not runoff, where the tail is held rather than sold, and an exit that pays the stayers rather than the reverse.

House kept on the children's clock: the divorcing spouse who leaves has their share of the house frozen in it until the youngest child is eighteen, the Mesher order of English family courts; conserved is a third party's use of the very thing the parties are dividing, the cost falls on the leaver in years of illiquidity, and the next entrant learns that some exits run on a non-party's clock; not a deferred sale by agreement, since a court can impose it on parties who could not agree and the clock belongs to neither of them even when they consent to it.

Chair filled before it's empty: the exit is dated by the successor's existence rather than the leaver's readiness, as a chief executive announces departure only in the sentence that names who follows; conserved is continuity of command with no vacancy for factions to fill, the cost falls on the leaver, who serves past their wish, and on the successor, who is known before they hold power, and the next entrant learns whether a bench existed; not a notice period, which is a duration, but a conditional date, and it can be improvised by any leaver willing to wait.

Runoff: the insurer leaves a market by writing nothing new and paying every policy to its natural end, as a carmaker leaving a country keeps shipping parts for a decade; conserved is the coverage the customers bought, the cost falls on the leaver in capital tied up for years in a shrinking operation nobody wants to staff, and the next entrant learns that an exit from a market lasts as long as the longest promise made in it; not reinsurance to close, since the tail is held rather than sold, and it needs no clause at entry, only capital.

Keys on the counter: the borrower who cannot pay hands over the collateral rather than defaulting into a foreclosure, the deed in lieu, the ship surrendered to the mortgagee at the next port; conserved is the collateral's value, spared a year of litigation, vacancy, and stripping, and the borrower's record, the cost falls on the borrower in the equity surrendered, and the next borrower learns that the loan was a lease with an option while the next lender learns that a clean surrender is worth a waived deficiency; bilateral and improvised at the door, not bankruptcy, which summons every creditor.

Sold to the people inside: the owner exits to buyers who were already in the building, the employees, usually taking a note paid from the business's own profits; conserved is the location, the workforce, and the knowledge in the hands that stay, the cost falls on the seller in a lower price and years of exposure to how the buyers run it, and the next entrant learns that an exit paid from the thing sold is not complete until the thing has paid; not a management buyout with outside capital, since the price is financed by what was exited, and it depends on a dated record of what was handed over, since every later shortfall in the note will be blamed on the day of the sale.

Leave the comb: the leaver takes only what walks, people and know-how, and forfeits every fixed asset to the stayers, as a trading desk lifted out of a bank walks with its know-how and whichever clients follow and leaves the book, the desks, and the name, and as a swarm leaves with the old queen and half the workers and abandons comb, brood, stores, and a capped queen cell; conserved is the fixed capital, whole under the stayers, the cost falls on the leaver, who rebuilds from nothing fixed, and on the stayers, who lose half their hands, and the next entrant learns that what walked was never the firm's; the hive is an analogy, not a claim about bees, and this is not a fork, since nothing is copied, nor a buyout, since nothing is paid; the timing, leaving when the cell is capped rather than when the new queen emerges, is offered as speculation about firms.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: buy-sell clauses, pay-to-play dilution, redemption gates, swing pricing, the MariaDB fork, law-firm names, film companies, noren-wake, LP secondaries, Lloyd's reinsurance to close, Mesher orders, deeds in lieu, employee buyouts, a swarm; drawn from insurance, software, restaurants, funds, family law, shipping, open source, and the hive.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism; Leave the comb carries a trade instance (the desk lifted out of a bank) beside an analogy from the hive marked as such; Queue at the door's account of why some 2008 gates kept their investors is an authored reading, marked as such; the only speculation is the timing claim carried by the Chair filled before it's empty → Leave the comb edge and by Leave the comb's last clause, both marked.

boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real exit usually runs several of these at once (a formula funded by insurance, paced by a queue, recorded at a witnessed boundary), and the list makes no claim to cover every kind.

'Clean' is taken narrowly: something named survives the leaving that the default exit, dissolution, foreclosure, or a fight over price, would have destroyed. Exits in which nothing survives, and departures in which the party never really leaves (a sabbatical, a silent partner), are outside.

The seriation, where the exit's terms were fixed relative to the leaving, is an itinerary, not a ranking of fairness, cost, or frequency; the reading that entry-designed exits work by a veil over who will leave is an authored interpretation, and map edges are conditional authored claims.

Illustrative cases (Lloyd's reinsurance to close and the open years, Mesher orders, noren-wake, the MariaDB and LibreOffice forks, deeds in lieu, LP secondaries, swing pricing, pay-to-play, film companies) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories; the swarm in Leave the comb is an analogy, and the timing claim carried by the Chair filled → Leave the comb edge is speculation; Reinsurance to close's 'walk free of it forever' is the practical position, not the legal one, since RITC is a contract of reinsurance rather than a novation and the closed year's members remain liable if the reinsuring year fails.

Adjacent lists: pivot-invariants names the priced release and the release that leaves no veto as retained assets, and this map adds who buys the exit and who pays for it; cooperation-mechanisms names high exit costs and automatic sunsetting as stabilizers, and this map takes the exit itself as the object; cooperation-integrity-hinges' Exit bandwidth asks whether the door can be reached before exposure, and this map asks what the door is made of. Further adjacencies named by the critic: impasse-inventions' The sunset is Everyone leaves at once seen as a bargaining chip rather than as the abolition of leaving; deal-flow-attractors' Written first look is the first-refusal clause the Sell the seat → Drag and tag edge names; cooperation-integrity-hinges' Liability horizon asks what backs a harm after the project ends, which Runoff and Reinsurance to close answer with who holds the tail and who pays for it. What an exit 'teaches the next entrant' is what the mechanism makes legible, not evidence that entrants read it; nothing here has been checked against a set of actual exits.

seriation.axis: Where the exit's terms were fixed relative to the leaving: from the contract at entry, behind a veil over who will leave (price, schedule, consent, time, money, license, name, term), through terms the trade fixed before this deal existed (custom, a market for seats, an institution that buys tails), to terms a third party fixes at the door, and finally to exits improvised between parties who both know who is leaving, ending where nothing was fixed at all and the leaver takes only what walks.
seriation.note: An authored walk along where the exit's terms were fixed relative to the leaving, not a scale of fairness or of design quality. Shotgun at the table opens it because its terms are fixed at entry and depend on nobody knowing which side they will stand on; Leave the comb closes it because nothing was fixed at all, the leaver takes what walks and the stayers keep what stands, which is the default beneath every custom. The first nine are contract-level designs made behind that veil (price, schedule, consent, time, money, license, name, term); Dividing the curtain, Sell the seat, not the house, and Reinsurance to close are designed by the trade before this deal existed; House kept on the children's clock has its terms set by a third party at the door; the last five are improvised between parties who both know who is leaving. Everyone leaves at once → Dividing the curtain is the hinge from contract to trade: the sunset is the last thing a contract can do about exits (abolish them), and the curtain is the first thing a trade does when contracts cannot (lend the name by custom). The consequential adjacency is Sell the seat, not the house → Reinsurance to close: the buyer of the exit shifts from a stranger to the stayers and the price from a discount to a premium, teaching that when no stranger will buy a seat the stayers are the buyer of last resort and set the price, and that when the stayers cannot price it either, as with the asbestos years, nobody leaves; this is why every entry-designed exit on the first stage fixes the stayers' take in advance.

exploration.first_question: Which exits from a partnership, deal, market, or cooperation leave what remains standing, and which of them can only be built at entry while others can be improvised at the door?
exploration.changed_question: The sort into designed-at-entry and improvised came out as a sort of who pays: every entry-designed exit fixes the stayers' take before anyone knows who will leave, so the leaving becomes an execution rather than a bargain, and every exit improvised between known parties is paid by the leaver, who has no veil to stand behind. The question became: when no veil was drawn at entry, what stands in for it? The answer that arrived was the trade itself, which designs exits one level above the contract, as custom (the curtain), as a market for seats (secondaries, runoff acquirers), or as an institution (reinsurance to close), so that the designed/improvised line is drawn not by the deal but by how old the trade is, and the first framing's assumption that an exit is a subtraction on a date gave way to exits by substitution and exits with no date.

priorities.item: Sell the seat, not the house: the leaver's place is sold to a substitute the stayers accept, as a limited partner sells its fund interest on the secondary market, a tenant assigns a lease, a member sells an exchange seat; conserved is the venture untouched and a seat never empty, the cost falls on the leaver in the discount a stranger demands and on the stayers in the consent they must give, and the next entrant learns whether a market for their seat exists, which is a property of the trade, not of the deal; substitution rather than subtraction or copy, and the leaver is not gone but replaced.
priorities.why: It is the item that moved the question, it can be checked against documents rather than histories, and it predicts a legible pairing between whether a stranger can buy a seat and what the entry papers say.
priorities.next_question: Take ten partnership forms in one city (law, medicine, dentistry, taxi medallions, restaurants, a fund, a co-op grocery, a marina, a trade exchange, a cemetery board) and for each ask whether a stranger can buy a member's seat; predict that where they can, the entry documents carry a consent or assignability clause older than any current member, and where they cannot, exits run by formula or by fight, and count the exceptions.

priorities.why: Low plausibility that a hive's timing rule transfers to firms, high generative promise: it proposes that an exit should be timed to the successor's irreversibility rather than presence, which nobody has tested and which would change how departures are announced.
priorities.next_question: Take twenty founder departures with a named successor and code each for whether the announcement came when the successor's appointment was irrevocable but not yet begun (signed contract, start date ahead) or after arrival, then count senior departures in the following two quarters; the swarm predicts fewer under the first timing, and a null result would kill the edge without touching the item.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing the two edges that carried the deal-to-trade passage (a runoff book is a seat sold below zero, and tag rights do not pre-grant a seat sale), restoring the insurance-funded buy-sell the ledger said it kept in the fork edge, and repairing five items for modality, for a case that leaked from the queue into the chair, and for a trade instance missing from the swarm.

neighbors.left: Name stays on the door: the founder retires and the firm keeps their name, as law firms are named for partners dead a century; conserved is the reputational asset detached from the person, the cost falls on the leaver, who loses control of what their name is now used to do, and on the stayers, who inherit every scandal the name will be attached to, and the next entrant learns that the name became the firm's on the day the shingle went up in firm form; the reverse of the curtain, since the name stays and the person goes, and it was designed at entry by the choice of what to paint on the glass.
neighbors.right: Dividing the curtain: a long-serving employee leaves to open their own shop under the master's name with the master's blessing and no fee, the noren-wake of Japanese restaurants and shops; conserved is the name, now in two places, and the master's standing, which grows with each shop bearing it, the cost falls on the master, who loses the hands and takes any disgrace the second shop earns, and the next entrant learns that years served are the price of the name; not a franchise, since no fee flows and no contract binds, and not the fork, since the name is shared rather than kept by the stayer.
neighbors.separating_case: A sushi master retires and the shop keeps his name under his senior apprentice: the name stays and the person goes, the stayers inherit the reputation and its risks, and the entrant learns the name was the shop's. Years later the second apprentice leaves to open a shop across town under the same name with the master's blessing: the name travels with the leaver, the master forgoes the hands and takes the risk, and the entrant learns the name was the master's to give. Same name, same three people, exits in opposite directions, and the two cannot be told apart by the sign on the glass, only by who painted it there and whether a person or a firm holds the brush.

checks.boundary_case: Dissolution at will, the default of partnership law under which any partner may end the firm at any moment and force a liquidation, is out: it is an exit that destroys what remains by design, and every member of this map is a device built to escape it. A non-compete is out for the opposite reason: it restricts the leaver and conserves nothing across the exit, a wall rather than a door. Runoff is in on exactly that contrast, since the leaver stays bound but the customers' coverage survives.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals at Shotgun at the table → Price fixed behind the veil: at entry the partners must choose discovery or formula, and which is safe is decided by their purses, not by the business. It shows a loop, Queue at the door ↔ Swing price, where a long queue causes the run it was built to prevent and the swing price that slows the run is itself a reason to leave. It shows a passage between levels at Runoff → Sell the seat, not the house, where a deal's improvised exit becomes the trade's designed one once a market for tails exists, and a second passage at Leave the comb → Dividing the curtain, where the default beneath every exit becomes a custom once the trade blesses it. It shows a dependency at Sell the seat, not the house → Drag and tag, where the trade-level market exists only where a contract-level clause pre-granted consent. And it shows an incompatibility at Everyone leaves at once → Name stays on the door: a trade whose ventures sunset cannot grow a name that stays, so its names attach to persons. The bare sequence would have shown none of these, since the seriation puts Runoff after Sell the seat and Leave the comb after Dividing the curtain, the reverse of the direction the edges run.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context, not a self-read: the critic tried to break the item type with an earn-out and a right of first refusal and the closest pair with Queue at the door and Chair filled before it's empty, found the items to be mechanisms and the strange members (an exit that pays the stayers, an exit with no date, a seat sold below zero, a name lent for years served, a venture that abolishes leaving, a swarm that leaves at the capping of the cell) kept strange rather than softened into advice, and repaired specifics without replacing any mechanism with a more respectable one.

name: market-deaths
of: A mechanism by which a market that was clearing trades stops being a market while it may still quote and while the lot's use goes on, named with the carrier that kills it, the tell that it is already dead behind the quote, and what a rebirth would require, sorted by what the death leaves standing for the next market, from deaths that only move the market to deaths that spend a belief or an ignorance nobody can resupply.
items: Copy takes the crowd: a market whose lot can be copied exactly at another address dies at the old address on the day the copy holds enough of the crowd that the rest follow for the crowd's sake, as the Bund contract left London's pit for Frankfurt's screen within a year once the electronic copy passed its tipping share; the tell is volume falling while open interest holds, since positions are being closed at the old address and opened at the new one; nothing is spent, the market lives at the copy, and the old venue is reborn only by becoming a copy of something else; not a market death so much as the death every other death here is measured against, since it is the one that leaves everything standing.

Sunk into the bundle: a market for a lot dies when deciding whether to buy the lot costs the buyer more than the lot is worth, so the lot is absorbed into a plan and its price survives only as an allocation line, as the ninety-nine-cent song died into the subscription and lives on as a per-stream royalty that no buyer pays; the tell is a price still printed and never paid by a buyer; reversible by unbundling, since the unit still exists inside the plan, and checked bags and airline meals were reborn exactly that way; adjacent to pricing-unit-metamorphoses, which follows the unit through its changes, this names the interval in which the unit has no market at all.

Died into a queue: a market dies by decree of its price when the decree holds the price below what clears, so rationing moves from the price to the line and the market survives as a queue that grows the forbidden sale back as a bribe for a place in it, as rent control breeds key money; the tell is a posted price with a waiting list beside it; reversible by decontrol, but the stock the price was meant to protect has been let rot in the interval and the first free prices are a birth from imported comps, as Cambridge found in 1995; the inverse of market-births' Queue to hijack, which is a market born on a queue, this is a market dying into one.

Slowed past the rot: a market that manufactured its thickness by fixing an hour dies when arrivals fall below what fills the hour, since each seller who leaves lowers the choice a buyer expects and the buyers leave in turn, and the market's last move is to hold the sale less often, weekly then monthly, until the interval passes the shelf life of the lot, as county livestock rings close one by one; the tell is a lengthening interval, not a falling price; reversible by anything that lengthens the shelf life or shortens the distance, as video auctions did for cattle, and the final act is usually a merger with the neighboring ring, so the thin market's death is the copy's birth seen from the losing town.

Wall in one head: where the wall on which offers were compared was one broker's memory, the market dies with the broker's retirement while every buyer and seller still exists, as when the only broker in used presses of one make retires and the holders go back to not knowing each other; the tell is that the market has a telephone number; nothing is spent but the comparison operation, and the market is reborn by any wall, a list, a board, a successor who inherits the notebook; not Hand on the saddle, where the missing thing is the other side, since here both sides are present and only the place they met has died.

Witness starving: a benchmark rests on a physical market whose flow thins until one cargo sets the print for everything indexed to it, and the market dies as a market for the cargo on the day a cargo is traded to move the print rather than to move oil, since the physical trades are now bets on the paper written over them, as the Brent field declined to a few cargoes a month under contracts worth many times the field; the tell is a single trade moving the month's print, and a party with reason to make that trade; rebirth requires the assessor to widen the basket, which feeds the witness by changing the lot; not Warm corpse, where the trades have stopped, since here they continue, too few to bear the weight on them and made for the weight's sake.

Warm corpse: a price kept quoted after its trades have stopped because contracts reference it, so the reference keeps the corpse warm, as the interbank term-lending rate was submitted as judgment for a decade after the lending it named had ended, with hundreds of trillions written on it; the tell is that no submitter can name a trade at the print, and the print moves when the panel changes rather than when supply does; rebirth requires a new witness on an underlying that still trades and a statute to move the legacy contracts, since no single party to a contract can leave the corpse alone; not a fraud, which may or may not attend it, but a quote whose only buyer is the contract.

Farm comes back: a grade that let lots substitute fails when its issuer's word stops meaning what it says, so every lot must again be inspected to its own origin, which costs more than the trade, and the market dies not from distrust but from the cost of the inspections distrust demands, as the triple-A on structured paper failed in 2007 and each pool had to be re-underwritten loan by loan; the tell is a bid-ask that widens lot by lot rather than across the board, and buyers asking for the documents behind the grade; rebirth needs the grade's word re-credited, by a new grader or by the old one under a new rule, and in structured credit the old graders kept the job under risk retention, so what was re-credited was the rule and not the name; the reversal of market-births' Grade that erases the farm.

Print taken back: a market dies from the top when the party that made trades final unmakes one, since every later trade is then provisional, as the London Metal Exchange cancelled a morning of nickel trades in March 2022 and the participants who had won the cancelled trades took their volume elsewhere for two years; the tell is a rulebook that now shows the power, and, where a copy exists, its open interest rising in the same lot; where no copy exists the venue survives, distrusted, and its volume drifts back one uncancelled crisis at a time, as nickel's did; rebirth requires a clearer whose rulebook lacks the power, or the belief in finality rebuilt by crises that pass without a cancellation; not a default, which is a counterparty failing, but the witness declining to witness.

Question nobody asks: a market dies when a substitute prices the same want in a different unit, so the lot's price stops answering the question buyers ask, as natural ice by the block died against the refrigerator by the machine; the tell is the buyer's question changing unit, per block to per machine, and the market's last customers being those who cannot afford the machine, so the market dies from the top of its customer list; the price is not low but unconsulted, and rebirth comes only when the machine's cost becomes a per-lot price again, as owned servers died back into rented compute, an analogy rather than a history; not Memory set to zero, where the same good arrives free.

Bid that never blinks: a market dies while quoting when one side stops being able to refuse, as a central bank buying by rule comes to own half the bonds and the benchmark goes a day without a trade, or a dairy support price fills caves with government cheese; the tell is a price that sits on the floor for years and does not move on news, with inventory accumulating at the one buyer; rebirth requires the bid to leave, and when it leaves the market has no memory of a price without it, so the first free prints are a birth; not a monopoly buyer, who refuses at some price, but a buyer who has promised not to.

Fence rots: a lot that was a lot only because a fence was held dies when the fence goes unpoliced enough that the fenced right trades at the price of its paperwork while the underlying use goes on, as the New York taxi medallion fell from over a million dollars toward a tenth of it while more rides than ever were driven, a death still in progress since the fence is half held and the medallion half priced; the tell is the price of the fenced right falling faster than the price of the use, and the death is complete when the two no longer move together at all; rebirth needs the fence re-held, and the death spends the will to hold it, since the fence's beneficiaries are now a small ruined group and its violators are everyone's drivers; the reversal of market-births' Fence at the lot's edge, which the market could draw but only a state could hold, and not a crash of the right, which is a fence still held at a lower rent.

Memory set to zero: a market dies when a copy of the good arrives at no price, since the price memory is rewritten to zero and every later price reads as a surcharge on free, as the printed encyclopedia died against the free one and the paid article died against the free page; the tell is paying customers asking why they pay; the memory can be reset only by naming a different lot, membership rather than articles, and news took fifteen years to find one that held; the one death in which nothing is missing and the lot still exists, because what was spent was the number.

Died with the collectors: a market whose price memory lived in its buyers dies when the buyers become estates, so every holder is a seller with no memory and no buyer inherits it, as common stamps and porcelain figurines fell toward material value once the generation that knew their prices was in the ground; the tell is estate in every provenance, dealers' stock growing, and catalogues quoting prices no one pays; no rebirth of that market is possible, since memory kept in people is not resupplied, and a new generation may make a new market on the same objects with its own reason and its own prices; not Memory set to zero, where the number was rewritten, since here the number survives in old catalogues and the rememberers do not.

One sentence, all holders: a market whose holders all hold for the same reason is one sentence from death, since the sentence failing turns every holder into a seller in the same hour and the price is not low but absent, as money funds held because they never break the buck emptied in the week one broke it; the tell, before the day, is that ten holders asked why they hold give one answer; rebirth comes on a different reason, since the buyers who return are buying distress rather than the thing, so the reborn market has new holders and a new sentence; not a crash, which leaves holders with different reasons on both sides of it.

Hand on the saddle: a market that cleared for twenty years because the sponsor bid in every auction dies on the day the sponsor's hand lets go, and the death is instant because the other side was never there, as auction-rate securities cleared weekly until February 2008 and then failed together; the tell, visible all along, is the same bidder on every print; no rebirth followed, because what the death spent was the buyers' belief that an auction clears by itself, and a belief the death refuted cannot be resupplied by a new sponsor; not Bid that never blinks, where the standing bid is announced and priced, since here the bid was the costume the market wore.

Decreed sacred: a market dies by decree of the good when the community declares it unsaleable, and the transfers do not stop but change kind, moving by gift and by theft, as relics after the Lateran ban travelled by pious theft and organs since 1984 travel by donation chains; the tell is that the gift has a going rate; the death is easy and the reversal nearly impossible, a claim that rests on an asymmetry of standing rather than on any recorded repeal, since a good once declared sacred cannot be declared ordinary without the declarer looking like a seller; adjacent to market-births' Price-proof good, a good that payment changes, this is a good that a decree changes, and the asymmetry between the two directions is the finding.

Test before the pool: a market for risk dies when the risk becomes known before the trade, since the pool that priced the unknown dissolves into the certain-loss, who cannot be insured, and the certain-safe, who will not pay, as a genetic test does to a life-insurance pool; the tell is the seller asking for the test; what the death spends is ignorance, which no one can rebuild once the test exists, so rebirth requires a witness built not to see, as Canada's genetic non-discrimination act and the British insurers' moratorium forbid the life insurer to ask, while the American statute of that name covers health cover and leaves life cover to the test; the mirror of Farm comes back, which is death by too little known about the lot, this is death by too much.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: load boards, livestock rings, benchmark baskets, activation of the cancel button on an exchange, medallions, per-stream royalties, government cheese, relic theft, genetic tests; drawn from commodities, freight, structured credit, software, agriculture, collecting, insurance, church history, and central banking.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. The sorting by what the death leaves standing is the author's interpretation; the claim that ignorance, a refuted belief, a sacred decree, and the will to hold a fence cannot be resupplied from outside is analytical rather than measured; the remark that rented compute is natural ice reborn is an analogy and marked as one; no item is speculative or invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real death usually runs several of these at once (the auction-rate failure was a hand letting go, one sentence held by every holder, and a print with no trades behind it in the same week), and the list makes no claim to cover every way a market ends. The word market is used loosely across the items, sometimes for a venue (Copy takes the crowd) and sometimes for a lot (Sunk into the bundle); the map tolerates the looseness rather than resolving it.

The seriation is an itinerary of what the death leaves standing for the next market, not a ranking of severity, speed, or frequency, and not a prediction of which markets will die; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (the Bund migration, auction-rate securities, the interbank rate's judgment years, the Brent basket, the 2022 nickel cancellation, New York medallions, the song into the subscription, the Lateran ban, the Canadian and British genetic non-discrimination rules) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the full histories; the cloud-as-reborn-ice remark inside Question nobody asks is an analogy.

Price collapses, bubbles bursting, corners, and the failure of a participant are outside: a market that clears at a lower or a hostage price is alive. The lot itself ceasing to exist, as when the last lab that processed a film closed, is outside, since the good died and not the market; every admitted item has the lot's use surviving the market's death. Illegality is also outside as a death, since the fieldwork found that prohibition strips the grade, the fence, the witness, and recourse while the trade survives.
Whether a market should die is outside; Decreed sacred, Died into a queue, and Bid that never blinks describe what a decree does to a market's shape, not whether the decree is right.

seriation.axis: What the death leaves standing for the next market: from deaths that only move the market (its address, its wrapper, its rationing, its hour, its meeting place) through deaths that spend a precondition an outsider can resupply (a print's underlying, a witness, a grader, a clearer, a per-lot question a new machine can reopen, a refusing buyer), to deaths that spend something kept in a polity, a number, or people (the will to hold a fence, the price memory, its rememberers), which only trading or resolve remakes and only from a seeded first price, to deaths that spend a belief or an ignorance the death itself refuted, which nobody can resupply.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of severity or a forecast. Copy takes the crowd opens it because nothing is spent, only the address; Test before the pool closes it because what was spent was ignorance, and knowledge does not unlearn. The first hinge is Wall in one head → Witness starving, where the walk crosses from deaths that leave every precondition intact to deaths that consume one, and the consequential adjacency is One sentence, all holders → Hand on the saddle: both are deaths of the other side, but the run spends the diversity of reasons, which distress buyers resupply on a different sentence, while the sponsor's withdrawal spends the buyers' belief that the auction cleared by itself, which no new sponsor can resupply, so between those two neighbors the walk crosses from what trading remakes to what the death refuted. Fence rots, Memory set to zero and Died with the collectors sit together as the three places a market's standing memory can be kept, in a polity's will, in a number, and in people, and only the last cannot be reseeded. Two slots moved at the critic's argument (Fable critic, 2026-09-07): Fence rots left the resuppliable band because its own text says the death spends the will to hold the fence, which no outsider resupplies, so it now follows Bid that never blinks; Question nobody asks moved up into the resuppliable band because it spends the buyer's question rather than the price memory, and its rebirth, the machine's cost becoming a per-lot price again, is resupplied by technology. Decreed sacred stands second from the end because its irreversibility is a social asymmetry rather than a logical one; a decree could in principle be repealed, and ignorance cannot.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanism does a market that was clearing trades stop being one, and which of those deaths can be reversed: read market-births backward, one death for each precondition that fails.
exploration.changed_question: What does the death leave standing for the next market? Reading the births backward produced three pointers that refused to be deaths: a copy that takes the crowd leaves the market alive at another address, a crash leaves it alive at a lower price, and illegality strips the grade, the fence, and the witness while the trade goes on. Among the deaths that remained, what varied was not which precondition failed but whether the next market could get it back, and the auction-rate case showed a death that spent nothing anyone had built, the buyers' belief that the auctions cleared by themselves. So the second breath asked which deaths refute the belief or the ignorance the next market would need, and found the death that spends ignorance itself.
exploration.new_member: Test before the pool: a market for risk dies when the risk becomes known before the trade, since the pool that priced the unknown dissolves into the certain-loss, who cannot be insured, and the certain-safe, who will not pay, as a genetic test does to a life-insurance pool; the tell is the seller asking for the test; what the death spends is ignorance, which no one can rebuild once the test exists, so rebirth requires a witness built not to see, as Canada's genetic non-discrimination act and the British insurers' moratorium forbid the life insurer to ask, while the American statute of that name covers health cover and leaves life cover to the test; the mirror of Farm comes back, which is death by too little known about the lot, this is death by too much.

priorities.item: Warm corpse: a price kept quoted after its trades have stopped because contracts reference it, so the reference keeps the corpse warm, as the interbank term-lending rate was submitted as judgment for a decade after the lending it named had ended, with hundreds of trillions written on it; the tell is that no submitter can name a trade at the print, and the print moves when the panel changes rather than when supply does; rebirth requires a new witness on an underlying that still trades and a statute to move the legacy contracts, since no single party to a contract can leave the corpse alone; not a fraud, which may or may not attend it, but a quote whose only buyer is the contract.
priorities.why: It is the death an operator is most likely to be standing inside without knowing it, since any contract that references a benchmark is a hand keeping some corpse warm, and the test costs an afternoon.
priorities.next_question: For one benchmark your contracts reference, pull the last twenty prints and count the actual trades behind each; if any print rests on fewer than three, plot the count against time to see whether the witness is starving or already judgment, and write down which of your contracts would need a statute, not a renegotiation, to move.

priorities.why: Low plausibility that a pool can be held open after the test exists, high generative promise: if a sealed result lets strangers pool, then ignorance can be rebuilt as an arrangement rather than a fact, and the map's closing item splits into deaths that spend ignorance and deaths that spend only its custody.
priorities.next_question: Assemble a small mutual, ten freelancers against a month of lost income, in which every member takes the relevant test and posts the sealed result to an escrow before the premium is set, with the seal opened only at claim; then let members retake the test privately and see whether those who learn they are safe leave, which would show that a sealed witness delays this death rather than reversing it.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing five items, two that failed the map's own boundary rule (a fenced right still clearing at a tenth, a starving witness whose trades continue) and three whose illustrative cases were overclaimed as history, relabeling the fork edge from Witness starving to Farm comes back so its consequent reaches the mechanism it names, softening two modalities (the Bund's months to a year; Decreed sacred's irreversibility named as an asymmetry of standing), and moving Fence rots and Question nobody asks to the bands their own texts argue for; the closest pair, the boundary case, the seriation, and the band-of-ignorance inference survived.

neighbors.left: Memory set to zero: a market dies when a copy of the good arrives at no price, since the price memory is rewritten to zero and every later price reads as a surcharge on free, as the printed encyclopedia died against the free one and the paid article died against the free page; the tell is paying customers asking why they pay; the memory can be reset only by naming a different lot, membership rather than articles, and news took fifteen years to find one that held; the one death in which nothing is missing and the lot still exists, because what was spent was the number.
neighbors.right: Died with the collectors: a market whose price memory lived in its buyers dies when the buyers become estates, so every holder is a seller with no memory and no buyer inherits it, as common stamps and porcelain figurines fell toward material value once the generation that knew their prices was in the ground; the tell is estate in every provenance, dealers' stock growing, and catalogues quoting prices no one pays; no rebirth of that market is possible, since memory kept in people is not resupplied, and a new generation may make a new market on the same objects with its own reason and its own prices; not Memory set to zero, where the number was rewritten, since here the number survives in old catalogues and the rememberers do not.
neighbors.separating_case: Sheet music after free scores went online: the memory of the music's price was rewritten to zero while the collectors of first editions remained, and their market lived on with its prices. Porcelain figurines: nothing ever became free, the catalogues still print the old prices, and the buyers left with the memory in them. The first is a number rewritten with the rememberers present; the second is the rememberers gone with the number intact, and only the first can be reseeded by renaming the lot.

checks.boundary_case: A price collapse is out: the oil price halved across 2014 and 2016 and the market cleared every day, so it was alive at a lower price. It comes in only where the collapse converts every holder into a seller in the same hour, which is One sentence, all holders, or reveals that nobody was ever on the bid, which is Hand on the saddle. Prohibition is out for the opposite reason: the trade survives with its grade, fence, and witness stripped, which is a deformation, not a death. The critic added a third: a market that stops because the lot itself ceases to exist, Kodachrome processing after the last lab closed, is out, since the good died and not the market; and a venue's insolvency is in, as Copy takes the crowd where a copy exists and as Wall in one head generalized where it does not.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals at Witness starving, which the itinerary places once but which splits by whether a substitute field exists: fed, it drifts into Farm comes back; unfed, it dies into Warm corpse. It shows an incompatibility at the limits between Farm comes back and Test before the pool, the same variable, how much is known about the lot, killing the market at too little and again at too much, so a risk market lives only inside a band of ignorance. It shows a dependency at Bid that never blinks → One sentence, all holders, where the floor manufactures the run that follows its removal, two deaths in sequence from one cause. It shows a ripening along the map's own axis at Sunk into the bundle → Memory set to zero, where the most reversible death ripens into an irreversible one from inside (the critic corrected the author's name for this edge: it is a movement along the axis, not a passage between levels of organization). It shows a second dependency at Decreed sacred → Died into a queue, where the sacred recruits the queue and the queue recruits the sale. And it shows that Print taken back kills only when Copy takes the crowd is available, the two ends of the itinerary joined by an edge the line cannot draw.
checks.target_preserved: Fable critic's judgment (fresh context, 2026-09-07), applied by the repairer: the strange members (a corpse kept warm by contracts, a hand on the saddle, a death by too much knowledge, relics moving by pious theft, a collectibles market that needs rememberers rather than wanters) were tested and kept as mechanisms; the critic tried to domesticate Died with the collectors into 'demand died with the generation' and declined; the five repairs sharpen where a death occurs or correct an overclaimed case, and none replaces a strange mechanism with a respectable one.

name: low-chair-advantages
of: A mechanism by which a low chair confers something the chair above cannot have, named with the carrier that keeps it (the beliefs of those above, the record kept about one, what one holds, the floor itself, or a second order held on purpose), the moment on rising at which it is lost, and what keeping it deliberately would cost.
items: Fool's license: words that arrive pre-discounted cannot be a challenge, so a truth passes from the fool that from a peer would have to be answered, as Lear's fool, or the junior on a trading desk who says the position is insane, is laughed at, and watches the desk quietly re-hedge; carried in the discount others apply, it ends the first time anyone acts on the words in the open, and a riser keeps it only by staying unheard; not credited sincerity, which works by being relied on, but a truth that works by needing no reply.

Word without a move: talk from someone who can gain nothing by it is read as information rather than positioning, so the junior's memo is read as analysis and the chief's as a move, as the Rule of Benedict sends the abbot to hear the youngest, or the shop assistant who says she would not buy it; carried in others' estimate of your stake, it is lost at the first stake, real or suspected; not the fool's license, which works by needing no reply, but credit, which works by being relied on.

Dumb question's price: the cost of revealing that you do not know is proportional to what your chair says you should know, so the obvious question that topples a ten-year ritual can be asked cheaply only from the bottom, as the new hire's 'why do we do this?'; lost on the day you are supposed to know, and it returns at the summit, where a Nobel makes Feynman's dumb question a display of security rather than a gap, so it is dearest in the middle; not fresh eyes, which a new chief also has and which do not lower the price of confessing.

Servant's eye: those above behave as if unobserved before a chair they do not count as an audience, so the low chair sees the natural behaviour no colleague sees, as the night nurse knows which surgeon is dangerous and the cleaner knows who is about to be fired; carried by the contempt of the watched, not by any hiding, it is lost the day they begin to perform for you, which is the day of promotion into the audience; the summit can rent it by disguise, as Haroun al-Rashid walked the market, and the rental expires once disguise is known to be a practice; not a hide, which the watcher builds, but a blindness the watched build themselves.

Barber's chair: the powerful confide on purpose in whoever cannot use what they hear, so the barber, the driver, and the assistant are told what the deputy never is; carried in the confider's estimate of your incapacity, it is lost the moment you gain the capacity to act, as the assistant made a vice-president is told nothing thereafter, and it binds where the servant's eye did not, since what is told is owed secrecy and what was overheard is owed nothing; not unknowing exposure but knowing disclosure.

I just work here: acts and messages are attributed to the chair above, so the low chair can carry word between enemies or execute a decision without owning it, as the cook who passes between the factions or the clerk whose policy is not hers; carried in attribution, it is lost at the first signature, and its price is never being the author; its dark twin is the soldier's 'following orders', the same mechanism with the moral bill visible; not discounted speech but displaced authorship.

Costless no: a refusal says nothing about the asker when nobody expected a yes, so the low chair can ask fifty times where the high chair can afford to ask once, as the unknown freelancer's cold pitches or the intern asking the chief for coffee; the price of a probe is what its refusal reveals, and that is set by the chair; lost when your refusals become news, as the founder turned down in public; not the beggar's mouth, where the ask itself confesses need whether or not it is granted, since here the ask offers something and only the refusal could cost.

No file: nobody stores your failures or reversals, so they do not compound, as the open-mic comic who bombs two hundred nights or the unknown founder who pivots without a press cycle; carried in others' records rather than their beliefs, it is lost when the first success creates an audience that keeps you on file, and unlike a belief a file once opened does not close, so it is the one advantage no riser gets back except under a new name; not a costless refusal or an unguarded opening, but what happens to an event after it.

Beggar's mouth: asking for help costs status, so the chair with none asks for free while the high chair cannot ask without a fall, as the ruined financier who cannot say he is broke or the senior partner who cannot say the caseload is beyond her; carried in the status you hold, it is lost on the first rung, and the loss kills, since the newly high lose the ask before they lose the need; not a costless probe, which offers something, but a confession, paid whether or not it is answered; and not the dumb question, which the summit can wear as curiosity, since need can be worn as nothing but need.

Small change: a published rate is a signal and taking less damages it, so the whole lower market of work is reachable only by the chair whose rate is low, as the star who cannot play weddings or the former executive whom the shop calls overqualified; carried in the price attached to your name, it is lost at the first published high price, which is why a fall from a high chair goes past the floor rather than onto it; keepable by keeping the rate low, that is by refusing the income the rise offered; not favours and not help, but paid work.

Stone's blood: civil enforcement costs more than it recovers from someone with nothing seizable, so the low chair is not worth suing for the small and uncollectible for the large, as the judgment-proof debtor or the tenant whose deposit is the landlord's whole remedy; the shield is civil only, since the state prosecutes the small against the poor at its own expense; carried in your holdings, it is lost at the first attachable asset, a wage or a deed, which is why the first pay rise of a rising person is also the day the creditors return; keepable only by holding nothing in your own name, which is a fraud or a vow; not the freedom to move but the immunity from being moved against.

No hostages: a move that would expose assets is open only to the one who has none, as the immigrant enters the trade the native cannot enter without losing face, or the challenger sells the thing that would cannibalise the incumbent; carried in what you hold, it is lost at the first acquisition worth defending, which is what winning is, and it can be kept only by vow, the monastic engineering of refusing to own; not the price of a refusal but the price of a move, and not immunity from being moved against.

Expendable scout: the low chair is sent first into the new or the dangerous because it can be lost, and so holds the frontier's knowledge before anyone above it, as the junior developer given the untried framework, the private issued the new weapon, the youngest son who emigrates; carried in your expendability, it is lost when you become too valuable to risk, and the knowledge is owed upward, unlike the free mover's; not a move chosen because nothing is held, but one assigned because you are cheap.

Ladder credit: where cash can settle, no obligation accrues, so the one who pays is owed nothing and the one who cannot pay builds credit in favours, the one credit line a cash crash does not close, as the borrowed ladder that comes back as harvest help or the neighbour who minds the children and is repaid in a roof, and the exchange rate favours the poor, since gratitude is priced by sacrifice; carried in the known inability to pay, it is lost the day neighbours learn you can, when they stop owing and start billing; adds to obligation futures the exclusion, that cash sterilises the account; not the allies of many seats but the credit they enforce, and not the susu, which is cash the floor enforces.

Many seats: a chair with many occupants and nothing beneath it has peers who are not rivals, so its honest feedback and mutual aid come free, where the high chair's peers compete and its subordinates cannot be friends, as the enlisted against the officers, the nurses' station, the cell block; lost the day you become the boss of your friends, and kept only by not competing for the next chair, since the same floor that lends is the floor that can hold you down; not the virtue of the occupants but their number.

Bosun's knowledge: the present state of the machine, which valve sticks, which workaround is load-bearing, which gauge lies, lives where the work is done and the chart above it is a model, as the bosun against the captain or the charge nurse against the attending; carried by the work itself, it decays at the rate the machine changes once you leave the floor, and it is the one advantage a riser keeps by continuing to take a shift, at the price of the hours the promotion was supposed to buy; not skill, which is portable and keeps, but the machine's current state, which is neither.

Second chair: a riser keeps the advantages that live in others' beliefs only by holding a genuinely low seat in a separate order, the white belt, the church basement, the amateur choir, where the discount, the harmlessness, and the cheap question can form again; not disguise, which fails once known, since the second chair really is low; lost the day the two orders touch and the dojo learns what you do on weekdays; the map's own proposal, and the one member that is a mechanism for keeping rather than for having.

source.register: Mechanistic and concrete: court fools, trading desks, night nurses, bosuns, barbers, judgment-proof debtors, susus, cell blocks, the Benedictine chapter, the dojo; drawn from trades, institutions, and the lives of people who must keep a floor under themselves.
source.mode: Clearly separated mixture: analytical mechanisms with observed illustrative cases for sixteen members, each simplified to one mechanism; the summit's recovery of two belief-borne members is an analytical reading with a speculative reach; Second chair is the map's own proposal and is marked so in its text.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real low chair usually holds several of these at once, and some hold none, since each depends on a carrier that a particular low chair may lack (the invisible nurse who is nonetheless fully on file).

The seriation is an itinerary by where the advantage is kept, not a ranking of value or of how often each occurs; the assignment of a member to a carrier is an interpretation (Costless no could be read as record-borne rather than belief-borne, and Beggar's mouth, placed with the holdings, is carried by status, which is made of others' beliefs), and map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (Lear's fool, the Rule of Benedict's chapter, Haroun al-Rashid's market walks, the susu, Feynman's questions, the undercover chief) are simplified to one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories; the wolf pack was left out because its status science is contested.

The summit's recovery of an advantage (the disguised king, the laureate's dumb question) is claimed for two belief-borne members only, as an analytical reading with a speculative reach; no claim that any other member returns at the top, and Second chair is the map's own proposal rather than an observed institution.

Advantages that are transfers from an audience (sympathy for the underdog, charity) are outside, since the audience can withdraw them and the chair cannot operate them; but that criterion alone is leaky, since the fool's discount is equally others' to withdraw, so the sharper exclusion, the Fable critic's, is that the low bar (credit for a competent deck from the intern), the under-defended first strike, and the first cold pitch that lands are spent by the first success rather than lost by exposure, and this map's axis, where the advantage is kept, has no place for advantages consumed by use; they belong to a map of what the first success costs, with No file at the joint. The costs of the low chair (the scapegoat, the crab bucket, the scout's risk) appear only as the price of a member.

seriation.axis: Where the advantage is kept, and so what moment loses it: from advantages held entirely in the beliefs of those above (lost the instant they look again), through what others record about you (lost when the file opens, which it never un-does), through what you yourself hold, status, a price, seizable things (lost at the first acquisition, keepable by vow), to what the floor holds, the work itself and the floor's own enforcement (lost on leaving the floor for the work-borne pair, keepable by keeping a shift; lost when those above learn you can pay or are worth keeping for the floor-enforced pair, which can happen while you still stand on it), and finally to a second order held on purpose.
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scale of value, rarity, or difficulty. Fool's license opens it because nothing carries it but the discount others apply, and one open act on the fool's words ends it; Second chair closes it because it is not kept in this order at all. The walk passes through four carriers, and each carrier has its own price of keeping and, for three of them, a single moment of loss: belief-borne members (Fool's license through Costless no) are lost on being seen and can be kept only by concealment or, for two of them, regained at the summit; No file alone is record-borne and is never regained; holdings-borne members (Beggar's mouth, Small change, Stone's blood, No hostages) are lost on acquiring and can be kept by refusing to own, which is what a vow of poverty engineers; floor-borne members (Expendable scout, Ladder credit, Many seats, Bosun's knowledge) are kept by the floor's structure and enforcement, and the block's loss moment splits, as the Fable critic showed: Bosun's knowledge and Many seats are lost on leaving the floor and kept by staying on it, while Ladder credit (lost the day neighbours learn you can pay) and Expendable scout (lost when you become too valuable to risk) are lost by a change in the beliefs of those above that can happen while you still stand on the floor, so they sit nearer the belief-borne members than the block label first admitted. Beggar's mouth is placed in the holdings block as status held, but status is what the belief-borne carriers are made of and its loss moment, the first rung, is a being-seen moment; the placement is an interpretation, like Costless no's. The hinge is Bosun's knowledge → Second chair: both keep an advantage by spending hours in a low place, but the bosun's floor belongs to the same order as the captain's chair, so the knowledge flows up and the belief-borne members do not return (the crew performs for a captain who stands a watch), whereas the second chair is a separate order, so the belief-borne members return and the work-borne ones do not transfer; the adjacency teaches that what a riser can keep depends on whether the low place is inside or outside the order they rose in. Inside the holdings block, Stone's blood → No hostages is the pair that shares one carrier and one loss moment, which is why the first rung is the most dangerous: the pay rise that returns the creditors is the acquisition that gives you something to defend.
