exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does a low chair confer something the chair above cannot have, and which of these can be kept on purpose by someone who rises, as against those available only to someone who genuinely has nothing?
exploration.changed_question: Where is each advantage kept, and is the moment of its loss the moment of being seen, of being recorded, of acquiring, or of leaving the floor? Breath one's members almost all lived in the beliefs of those above, and the answer to 'which can be kept' was a single one: only by not being seen. Sharpening Costless no against No file separated a belief held now from a record kept later, with different loss moments, and the carrier turned out to decide the keeping: what is kept in others' heads is kept by concealment or a second order, what is kept in one's holdings is kept by vow, what is kept in the work is kept by a shift.
exploration.new_member: Small change: a published rate is a signal and taking less damages it, so the whole lower market of work is reachable only by the chair whose rate is low, as the star who cannot play weddings or the former executive whom the shop calls overqualified; carried in the price attached to your name, it is lost at the first published high price, which is why a fall from a high chair goes past the floor rather than onto it; keepable by keeping the rate low, that is by refusing the income the rise offered; not favours and not help, but paid work.

priorities.item: Small change: a published rate is a signal and taking less damages it, so the whole lower market of work is reachable only by the chair whose rate is low, as the star who cannot play weddings or the former executive whom the shop calls overqualified; carried in the price attached to your name, it is lost at the first published high price, which is why a fall from a high chair goes past the floor rather than onto it; keepable by keeping the rate low, that is by refusing the income the rise offered; not favours and not help, but paid work.
priorities.why: It is the survival mechanism the map's first framing could not see at all, since it lives in a labour market's price signals rather than in anyone's regard, and it predicts something checkable: that a fall from a high chair overshoots the floor.
priorities.next_question: For one trade with a public rate ladder, session and touring musicians, list twenty players with their published rate and ask each whether they can be booked at the wedding rate under their own name; the prediction is that above some published rate no wedding booking exists at any price, and that the players who still reach that market do so under a second name or through a fixer who hides the rate.

priorities.item: Second chair: a riser keeps the advantages that live in others' beliefs only by holding a genuinely low seat in a separate order, the white belt, the church basement, the amateur choir, where the discount, the harmlessness, and the cheap question can form again; not disguise, which fails once known, since the second chair really is low; lost the day the two orders touch and the dojo learns what you do on weekdays; the map's own proposal, and the one member that is a mechanism for keeping rather than for having.
priorities.why: Low plausibility that it works as cleanly as written, high generative promise: it is the only member that answers the live question for the belief-borne class without deception, and it makes a testable claim about what happens when two status orders touch.
priorities.next_question: Find three risers who hold a known low seat in a separate order, a chief who is a white belt, a surgeon in an amateur orchestra, a bishop in a church-basement meeting, and record whether people in the second room say to them what nobody at work would; then find the day the room learned their weekday chair and ask whether the advantages died that day or survived because the low seat had been earned before the discovery.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing three items (a civil-only shield in Stone's blood, a cash case moved out of Ladder credit, a summit discriminator added to Beggar's mouth) and three edge labels (subject-relative dumb question, floor-enforced credit in any currency, anonymity named as the alternative to a second chair); the 'work-borne' block's loss moment is noted as mislabeled for two of its four members. The fourth seriation block is relabeled floor-borne with its split loss moment; no items cut; order unchanged.

neighbors.left: Fool's license: words that arrive pre-discounted cannot be a challenge, so a truth passes from the fool that from a peer would have to be answered, as Lear's fool, or the junior on a trading desk who says the position is insane, is laughed at, and watches the desk quietly re-hedge; carried in the discount others apply, it ends the first time anyone acts on the words in the open, and a riser keeps it only by staying unheard; not credited sincerity, which works by being relied on, but a truth that works by needing no reply.
neighbors.right: Word without a move: talk from someone who can gain nothing by it is read as information rather than positioning, so the junior's memo is read as analysis and the chief's as a move, as the Rule of Benedict sends the abbot to hear the youngest, or the shop assistant who says she would not buy it; carried in others' estimate of your stake, it is lost at the first stake, real or suspected; not the fool's license, which works by needing no reply, but credit, which works by being relied on.
neighbors.separating_case: The junior on the desk who says the position is insane. If the desk laughs and re-hedges without saying so, the words worked by discount, nobody had to answer them, and the junior's chair is intact for next time: Fool's license. If the head trader says in the meeting that she is right, the words worked by credit, they were relied on because she had nothing to gain, and she is now a source: Word without a move. Same words, and the difference is whether anyone had to reply; and once relied on, the next thing she says is a move, so both licenses are gone together.

checks.boundary_case: Fresh eyes are out: the newcomer's not-yet-habituated perception is carried by novelty, not by the chair, since a new chief has fresh eyes too and pays full price for the obvious question the moment the honeymoon ends. Dumb question's price is in on exactly that contrast, since what the low chair confers is not the seeing but the cheapness of confessing.
checks.form_inference: The map shows an incompatibility the sequence conceals: Fool's license and Word without a move sit as neighbours on the itinerary, but the edge between them says the same words cannot be both unanswerable and relied on, so one open act on the fool's words converts the license into credit and ends it. It shows a dependency, Dumb question's price → Bosun's knowledge, where the question is dear over whatever your chair is supposed to hold and the floor's knowledge is exactly what the floor chair holds, so the bosun asks cheaply about the chart and dearly about the valve, and a riser who keeps a shift regains the knowledge while the question about it grows dearer. It shows a passage between levels at Servant's eye → Barber's chair, overhearing becoming being told at the price of a bond, and a second passage at Beggar's mouth → Second chair, out of this order altogether. It shows a loop the line cannot express, Stone's blood → Ladder credit → Many seats → Stone's blood, in which being uncollectible leaves only credit the floor enforces, in favours or in a susu's cash rounds, that credit recruits the floor to enforce it, and the floor holds you at the floor, so a rise breaks the loop at every point at once. And it shows a fork at No hostages → Expendable scout, where the same frontier knowledge comes back with different debts depending on who paid the fare.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context: the item type is real, the closest pairs separate under pressure (Fool's license against Word without a move on whether anyone had to reply; Dumb question's price against Beggar's mouth on whether the confession can be re-worn at the summit; Stone's blood against No hostages on a 2x2 of passive immunity against active freedom), and the strange members (a credit line that cash sterilises, a rate that makes a fall overshoot the floor, an ask that dies before the need does, a seat held in another order on purpose) survive as mechanisms; three items were repaired for a false generality, a self-contradicting case, and a misplaced case, and three edges relabeled where an 'only' or a 'must' had a counterexample, with no strange mechanism replaced by a respectable one.

name: runway-illusions
of: Mechanisms by which a person's or a firm's real time until it must stop, or what that time is worth, or how it answers to the operator's own moves, differs from what its cash balance over its burn predicts, each named with the carrier that holds the difference, what the cash figure misreads, and whether a better count corrects it or only a change in what is counted.
items: Date bomb: an obligation that arrives as a step rather than a slope, as the lease that renews in September, the annual premium, the tax bill in April, the tuition due before the school year, so the death is at the first step the balance cannot clear and not at the month the average burn predicts; the carrier is the calendar, the cash figure misreads a staircase as a ramp, and a better count corrects it, since the schedule was always on paper; the seasonal case, the fisherman's winter or the nine-month salary, is the same staircase repeated.

Reach the cliff: an asset that arrives as a step, as the vesting date, the pension's twentieth year, the bonus paid in March, the tranche released on a milestone, so the runway's worth is a step in its length, a race whose prize is a jump, and the whole loss is quitting three weeks early; the carrier is the payer's schedule, the cash figure misreads a binary as a slope, since the months before the cliff are worth nothing on their own and everything as a bridge; the same calendar as Date bomb read upward, and distinct in what it makes the operator do, since a step down is cleared by having the cash at the date while a step up is raced for by spending whatever reaches the date, so a cut that lengthens the months and misses the date is a loss and not a gain; a permission that arrives on a date, as naturalization at year five, is Stamp's clock read upward and not this.

Cash behind glass: money that is owned but cannot be reached in time, as deposits at a bank taken into receivership on a Friday, a retirement account behind a penalty, a receivable held in escrow, savings in a currency that cannot leave its country, so the runway runs on the reachable balance and the pipe's delay rather than on the owned one; the carrier is the pipe between the account and the payroll, the cash figure counts ownership where the clock runs on access, and a better count corrects it once the ledger has an access column, which it usually does not.

Burn you cannot put down: burn divides into what stops when you stop it and what stops only after notice, severance, or a lease's remaining term, so two firms with equal burn have unequal runways under cuts, and the first cut costs a step before it saves a slope; the carrier is the stack of commitments, the cash figure misreads one number for what is a floor and a ceiling, and a better count corrects it, since each commitment carries its notice period on paper; not Date bomb, which is one step on the calendar, since this is the shape of the whole burn under the operator's own hand.

Cost of the coffin: dying costs money, as the final payroll, the accrued leave, the lease break, the deposits returned, the accountant who closes the books, so the line at which a firm must stop is not zero but zero plus the cost of stopping cleanly, and the founder who runs the balance to nothing has already crossed it; the carrier is the wind-down bill, the cash figure misreads zero for the floor, and a better count corrects it; the creditor's covenant that calls the loan at a minimum balance draws the same line from outside, and sits here rather than under Watched burn because it is a written number, not an inference.

Near the pole: runway is cash over net burn, and net burn is the difference of two large flows, so two operators with identical months differ by how close their burn sits to the pole where income covers it, as a shop taking in ninety and spending a hundred has the same three months as a startup taking in nothing and spending ten, and only the shop can multiply its runway by a ten-percent cut; the carrier is the ratio of the gross flows to their difference, the cash figure misreads a point for the steepness of the curve the point sits on, and counting corrects it, but only if the gross flows are counted and not the net.

Hurry discount: assets counted at what they would fetch with time to sell fetch less the less time there is, as the inventory, the machinery, the house, the domain name, so the runway sets the pile's price and the pile's price sets the runway, and a first shortening of the clock shortens it again through the pile; the carrier is the depth of the market for a seller in a hurry, the cash figure misreads a stock as if its price stood still while the clock ran, and a count corrects it only by putting the clock inside the price and solving for the point where the two agree.

Watched burn: a burn that counterparties can see is repriced as they see it, as the landlord who asks for a larger deposit, the supplier who moves to cash on delivery, the investor who reads the bank statement, the buyer whose diligence finds the runway and waits for the price to fall, so terms tighten as the clock shortens and shorten it further; the carrier is the counterparties' inference from what they can observe, the cash figure misreads terms as fixed when they are a function of the perceived clock, and the correction is not a better count of the ledger but a count of what others can see of it.

The front: a runway that runs on the belief that it is long, as the house with no cash behind it, the firm that pays every vendor late but on an exact schedule, the officer's mess bill, so credit flows as long as the belief does and the death arrives on the day of the discovery rather than the day of the zero; the carrier is others' belief used as collateral, the cash figure misreads the clock as continuous when it ends at a step set by an exposure, and no count corrects it, since the quantity is a belief; Watched burn with the sign reversed: there, being seen shortens, here, not being seen lengthens.

Receivable from the dying: money owed to you by a customer whose own clock runs on your weather, as the subcontractor owed by a builder in a housing bust or the freelancer owed by the agency that lost the same client, so the receivable is a loan to someone whose death is correlated with yours, and it arrives as cash when least needed and as a loss when most; the carrier is the customer's balance sheet, the cash figure misreads a dated claim for cash to come, and a better count corrects the ageing but not the correlation, which appears only when the customer's runway is counted too.

Forbearance clock: a debt with no schedule, as the family loan, the supplier who lets the invoice slide, the tax authority that has not yet noticed, the credit line uncalled, is due at the creditor's discretion, and the creditor's discretion runs on the creditor's own runway, so the debt is patient exactly until the creditor is in trouble, which need not be when you are, and is when you are whenever the two of you share weather; the carrier is the creditor's clock, the cash figure misreads an uncalled debt as not due, and no count of your own ledger corrects it, since the due date lives in someone else's; Receivable from the dying on the other side of the sheet.

Too expensive to let die: a runway carried by the cost of your death to others, as the only doctor in the district, the engineer who alone knows the plant, the tenant whose leaving would empty a building in a bad market, so counterparties who could call the debt do not, because replacing you costs more than carrying you; the carrier is their replacement cost, the cash figure misreads your clock as yours when it is theirs, and it is corrected only by counting what your death costs someone else; not Forbearance clock, which runs on the creditor's health, since a creditor in trouble who cannot replace you keeps you alive for as long as it expects a future in which to need you, though a creditor in receivership has no replacement cost, since it has no future to replace you in, and its receiver calls the debt; and not a leverage, since nothing is exercised.

Lien of blood: savings that are yours on the statement and a family's in fact, as the immigrant whose balance is also a sibling's tuition and a parent's surgery, the couple whose joint account is one partner's runway and the other's veto, so the disposable balance is the statement minus every claim that will be made before the death and enforced by no one but you; the carrier is kinship claims on no ledger, the cash figure misreads ownership for disposability, and counting the claims corrects it, which most people can do and do not; the parents' spare room, on no ledger and lengthening the clock at a price in standing, is the same carrier with the sign flipped, and its price belongs to the status maps.

Weakest wallet: a group's runway is not the pooled cash but the shortest private clock among members who can leave, as the band that ends when the drummer's savings do, the founding team whose firm has eighteen months while a founder's own rent has four, so the group dies at the first departure and not at the pooled zero; the carrier is the members' separate accounts joined to their exit option, the cash figure misreads the pooled balance for the group's time, and counting each wallet corrects it; the monastery, one purse and no private clock, is the case where the pooled count is right, and shows that the illusion is the exit option and not the pooling.

Any-town skill: a skill that is cash in any town lengthens the runway to the time it takes to move, while a skill that is cash only here shortens it to the cash, as the nurse or the welder against the fixer who knows this council, the session player known in this scene, the courtier; the carrier is the geography of the market for the skill, the cash figure misreads the pile for the pump, and it is corrected only by counting where the skill sells and at what discount, which is a count of a market you are not yet in; not a floor under income, which is what the skill fetches, since here only where it fetches it matters, and the location of the floor is what sets the clock.

The back: the body is the asset that produces the income and is drawn down by producing it, as the carpenter's back, the nurse's nights, the surgeon's hands, the drummer's hearing, so the double shift that lengthens the cash runway spends the body's, and the two clocks run in opposite directions; the carrier is work capacity, the cash figure misreads the income as free of depreciation, and no count corrects it without a second ledger in a second unit, which is a change of what is counted; the ship's hull kept afloat by deferred repair is the firm's back, and comes due as a Date bomb with no date printed.

Stamp's clock: a permission that expires on a date no cash extends, as the visa's sixty-day grace, the enlistment, the student's enrolment, the parole, the license that lapses without hours logged, so the death is the stamp's date whenever it falls before the cash's, and every month of cash past it is worth nothing here; the carrier is the issuing authority's calendar, the cash figure misreads money for time where the two do not convert, and no count of money corrects it, since the clock is in a unit money does not buy; not Date bomb, whose step is cleared by paying.

Runway in shots: for anyone who must find a thing before the cash ends, a founder's product, a scientist's result, an actor's part, a prospector's seam, the runway is not months but trials, so halving the burn doubles the months and may leave the shots unchanged if the cut removed the trial capacity, and the same firm with three months is short at one shot a month and long at ten; the carrier is the trial rate, the cash figure misreads time for attempts, and the correction is a change of unit, not a better count; here the clock is not time at all, so no count in months, however good, touches it.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: leases, vesting dates, receivership weekends, severance, fire sales, subcontractors, mess bills, visas, district doctors, bands, immigrants, carpenters, a monastery; mechanisms with the misread quantity named, not advice.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. Two loop claims (the pile's price depends on the clock; terms depend on the perceived clock) are analytical and marked in the limits. Runway in shots is analytical in its cases and speculative in its generality, and the limits say where its contrast disappears. No invented worlds.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy of insolvency or a model of it; a real case runs several of these at once, and the list claims no coverage.

The seriation is an itinerary of how far the real clock lies from the cash ledger, not a ranking of danger, size, or frequency; map edges are conditional authored claims, and the two loops (Watched burn with Hurry discount, and the front's belief) are analytical, not measured.

The illustrative cases (a bank receivership weekend, a visa grace period, a subcontractor in a housing bust, an officer's mess bill, a district doctor) are simplified to one mechanism each and are not claims about specific histories, firms, or jurisdictions.

Runway in shots assumes the search has a trial rate that a burn cut can remove; where trials are nearly free, as a writer's drafts, the contrast with months disappears, so the item's generality is speculative and its cases are the ones where trials cost money.

Floors under income belong to the sibling map survival-floors and the price of a fall in standing to the status maps; here only the clock. The operator's nerve, the panicked exit that arrives before zero, was left as an unresolved seed rather than admitted, since its mechanism is not yet separable from mood. Adjacent to clocks-that-are-not-clocks, which reads durations off states; every item here is a clock read against the cash figure, and adds what the figure misreads.

seriation.axis: How far the real clock lies from the cash ledger: from arithmetic the ledger could have done itself (a calendar, a floor under burn, an access column, a fixed point for the pile), through counterparties who hold part of your clock in their ledgers or their beliefs, through the household, the coalition, and a market you are not yet in, to quantities in no monetary unit at all (the body, a stamp, a count of trials).
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scale of severity or of how often each occurs. Date bomb opens it because the correction is a calendar the operator already owns; Runway in shots closes it because there the clock is not time. The route answers the live question in three grades rather than two: items from Date bomb through Hurry discount are corrected by counting better inside one ledger; Watched burn through Any-town skill are corrected by counting someone else's ledger, belief, or market, which is still counting but not yours; The back through Runway in shots are corrected only by changing the unit. The hinge is Hurry discount → Watched burn: the discount is the last illusion solvable inside your own books, a fixed point where the clock and the pile's price agree, and it is also the mechanism by which your books become visible, since the hurried sale is what the counterparty sees, so counting better tips into counting what others count. The second turn is Any-town skill → The back: the skill's correction is a count of wages in another town, so it is the last carrier priced in money, and the body is the first that money does not buy; the critic moved Any-town skill here from the non-monetary grade, where the author had filed it, since its own correction is priced. Reach the cliff sits beside Date bomb because the two are the same calendar read up and down, and the adjacency teaches that a step down is cleared by having the cash at the date while a step up is raced for by spending whatever reaches it, so the same cut is a cure for one and a loss for the other. Too expensive to let die sits between Forbearance clock and Lien of blood because it is the last runway held by a stranger before the route enters the family.

relations.label: If the creditor's own clock is short but not out and you cannot be replaced, the forbearance outlives the creditor's trouble, since replacement cost overrides the creditor's health for as long as the creditor expects a future in which to need you; past the creditor's own death the override fails, a receiver has no replacement cost, and the runway that had moved from the creditor's ledger to the creditor's dependence ends with the creditor, so the operator who raises the cost of their own death has bought time bounded by the creditor's.

relations.to: Runway in shots: for anyone who must find a thing before the cash ends, a founder's product, a scientist's result, an actor's part, a prospector's seam, the runway is not months but trials, so halving the burn doubles the months and may leave the shots unchanged if the cut removed the trial capacity, and the same firm with three months is short at one shot a month and long at ten; the carrier is the trial rate, the cash figure misreads time for attempts, and the correction is a change of unit, not a better count; here the clock is not time at all, so no count in months, however good, touches it.
relations.label: If the burn that can be cut is the burn that buys trials, then a cut that moves the firm toward the pole lengthens the runway in months and shortens it in shots; the two units disagree about whether the cut helped, and the pole is a pole in months only, since a firm at breakeven with no trials has an infinite runway and no way to arrive.

exploration.first_question: Where does a person's or a firm's real time-to-death differ from what its cash over its burn says: which mechanism holds the difference, what carries it, and what does the cash figure misread?
exploration.changed_question: Is the clock cash at all, and which runways change length when they are counted? The first breath assumed death was the cash reaching zero and looked for mis-scheduled steps and mis-counted counterparties. Sharpening Watched burn against The front showed a runway whose length is a function of its own reading, sharpening Cost of the coffin showed the death line is above zero, and both together asked whether the answer must be a number of months. The second breath found the loop through the pile (Hurry discount), the clocks held by others (Too expensive to let die, Weakest wallet), and two runways in units money does not convert to (Stamp's clock, Runway in shots).

priorities.why: It can be run on public numbers, it separates operators the months figure calls identical, and it is the cleanest test of the map's first grade, that some illusions vanish under a better count of the same ledger.
priorities.next_question: Take ten small firms with the same reported months of runway and write each one's gross inflow and gross outflow beside the net; recompute the months after a ten-percent cut to outflow for each; the spread of the recomputed months across firms that started equal is the size of the illusion, and the firm whose months go to infinity is the one sitting on the pole.

priorities.why: Low plausibility that every search has a trial rate a burn cut can remove, high generative promise: it says the unit of runway is domain-dependent and that a cost cut can be a runway cut, which no cash figure can show, and it opens the question of what other quantities runway is really counted in.
priorities.next_question: For one lab or studio, count trials per month over the last year beside months of cash; propose the cut the finance lead would propose and recompute both; find the cut that lengthens months while shortening shots, and then the cut that does the reverse, and ask which one the operator would actually have taken.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after widening the item type to cover the runway's worth and its response to cuts, repairing five items (two modality overclaims in Forbearance clock and Too expensive to let die, a blurred fork in Reach the cliff, a delegated boundary in Any-town skill, a positional clause in Runway in shots), relabeling one edge so the creditor's-dependence runway is bounded by the creditor's survival, and moving Any-town skill out of the non-monetary grade.

neighbors.left: Forbearance clock: a debt with no schedule, as the family loan, the supplier who lets the invoice slide, the tax authority that has not yet noticed, the credit line uncalled, is due at the creditor's discretion, and the creditor's discretion runs on the creditor's own runway, so the debt is patient exactly until the creditor is in trouble, which need not be when you are, and is when you are whenever the two of you share weather; the carrier is the creditor's clock, the cash figure misreads an uncalled debt as not due, and no count of your own ledger corrects it, since the due date lives in someone else's; Receivable from the dying on the other side of the sheet.
neighbors.right: Too expensive to let die: a runway carried by the cost of your death to others, as the only doctor in the district, the engineer who alone knows the plant, the tenant whose leaving would empty a building in a bad market, so counterparties who could call the debt do not, because replacing you costs more than carrying you; the carrier is their replacement cost, the cash figure misreads your clock as yours when it is theirs, and it is corrected only by counting what your death costs someone else; not Forbearance clock, which runs on the creditor's health, since a creditor in trouble who cannot replace you keeps you alive for as long as it expects a future in which to need you, though a creditor in receivership has no replacement cost, since it has no future to replace you in, and its receiver calls the debt; and not a leverage, since nothing is exercised.
neighbors.separating_case: A supplier in its own trouble, calling every uncalled invoice it holds, who nevertheless carries one customer because that customer is the only outlet for a line the supplier cannot sell elsewhere. Under Forbearance clock alone the debt is called, since the creditor's clock has run out; under Too expensive to let die it is not, since the creditor's replacement cost exceeds the carry. The reverse case separates them the other way: a flush supplier who can replace you tomorrow keeps forbearing out of habit, which is the forbearance clock running on the creditor's health with no dependence at all.

checks.boundary_case: A sales pipeline counted as revenue is out: it is a miscount of cash, an error in the figure itself, and the map assumes the figure is right and asks what a right figure still misreads. The part of the pipeline that is a mechanism, the buyer whose diligence finds the runway and waits, is already Watched burn. Optimism is not a carrier. The critic's nonmember agrees: stretching payables is out because paying every vendor thirty days later moves the figure itself, so the months really are longer and nothing is misread; the creditor who tolerates the stretch is Forbearance clock and the stretch that is seen is Watched burn.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the sequence conceals: Watched burn → Hurry discount, where terms tighten on seeing the burn, the pile fetches less, and the hurried sale is itself seen, so the fixed point the discount could solve for inside one ledger moves once the solving is watched. It shows an incompatibility between neighbors, Watched burn and The front, where a cut that is seen ends the runway it was meant to extend, so past a point the operator cannot hold both. It shows a fork at Date bomb → Stamp's clock, where every dated death splits by whether cash converts to time. It shows a passage between levels at Lien of blood → Weakest wallet, where a person's corrected clock becomes the coalition's minimum. It shows a synchronization at Receivable from the dying → Forbearance clock, where two columns counted separately fail as one event. And it shows a second incompatibility at Near the pole → Runway in shots, where the same cut lengthens the runway in one unit and shortens it in the other.
checks.target_preserved: Judged by the Fable critic in a fresh context, not a self-read: the critic tested Date bomb against Reach the cliff and Forbearance clock against Too expensive to let die, kept every strange member as a mechanism (the runway that ends on the day of discovery, the clock held in a creditor's dependence, the group that dies at its poorest member, the runway in trials), and found that the map exceeded its declared type rather than fell short of it, so the type was widened to the runway's worth and its response to the operator's own moves while no item was softened into cash-management advice.

name: self-trust-repairs
of: A mechanism by which a person whose own judgment has become unusable to them, after being badly wrong or after being told so until they believed it, rebuilds a working reliance on it, named with the faculty repaired, the carrier that holds the repair, what it does when run alone, and when a witness may enter: never, only as a seal, only afterward, or as the repair itself.
items: Honest kitchen: the judgment is exercised where the world scores it within seconds and the score cannot be argued with, the sauce breaks, the boat rounds up, the note is flat, as a surgeon who missed the diagnosis takes up the cello; repairs the felt link between deciding and anything happening, carried by the medium's refusal to be persuaded, and it is a repair a witness ruins, since a watcher turns the world's verdict into a performance for the watcher and the sauce is then broken in front of someone; a witness may taste the result later but not stand at the stove.

Fresh ledger: judgment is moved to a domain where the person has no record yet and a record is built there before it is walked back, as a trader who lost the fund learns to sail and returns two seasons later able to say what he now does with a bad read of the wind; repairs the record by giving it a clean page, carried by the new domain's own scorekeeping, and alone it becomes flight, since the domain was chosen for being unscored and nothing forces the return, so the only witness it tolerates is the one who holds the return date, since the domain scores the hand itself and a watcher at the tiller is the kitchen's ruin; not Stranger's baseline, which keeps the domain and changes the audience.

One-turn key: a decision is made once under a rule that it will not be reopened before a fixed date, as a nurse who was wrong about a patient chooses her next post in one sitting and refuses herself the nightly re-vote until the probation ends; repairs the nerve to act ahead of confirmation, carried by the date rather than by conviction, and alone it fails because the judgment that must not reopen the decision is the one that rules on whether tonight counts as reopening, while a witness handed the decision itself has replaced the judgment rather than repaired it, so a witness may hold the calendar and never the key.

Silent minority report: when the room overrules the judgment, the overruled view is written and dated before folding, not spoken, and read back against the outcome months later, as a junior analyst keeps a private file of every forecast she was talked out of; repairs the survival of the person's own view across their own fold, since a view one folded on is the easiest to remember afterward as never held, and a dissent spoken and minuted is a different instrument that repairs standing before the room rather than before oneself; carried by the dated private note, silent because whoever can afford to speak the dissent does not need the file, so the file is the cheap trial of the expensive act; needs a witness later, since a file only its author reads is a slip without a seal, and the note must carry the date on which someone else opens it, or it becomes a second life.

Sealed slip: a small prediction is written, dated, and put where the writer cannot amend it before the outcome arrives, as a dismissed forecaster keeps a drawer of dated envelopes on the week's weather; repairs calibration, carried by the seal rather than by any person, and the seal guards only the content, since the grader is still the defendant, who can no longer revise an envelope but still chooses which ones to open and count, so alone it fails by selection where it no longer can by revision; not the count of calls, which is Long denominator's work, and not custody of the whole drawer, which is Borrowed bookkeeper's, but one call's honesty.

Long denominator: the verdict that broke the trust was one call in a record of a few, and the repair lengthens the record with hundreds of cheap calls until the disaster becomes a rate rather than a character, as an estimator drills daily guesses at distances and restaurant bills; repairs the meaning of a miss, carried by count, and alone it drifts toward calls that cannot miss, since a record of sure things lengthens nothing; not the seal, which guards one call, but the total the miss is divided by.

Weather rule: the conditions under which the judgment fails are catalogued, tired, flattered, hurried, when the number is round, and the judgment is trusted outside its known weather, as a pilot with one bad night rules out flying into that weather rather than out of flying; repairs the timing of decisions rather than the decisions, carried by the catalogue, and alone it works but shrinks, since each new miss adds a weather until nothing is flyable, so a witness may enter afterward as the reader who names a weather the pilot cannot see from inside it, flattery above all, and who refuses the catalogue an entry for every miss, never as the one who grounds the flight; not Which organ, which quarantines a faculty, and not Move ban, which quarantines an act.

Move ban: the one move that broke it is named and forbidden outright, the double-down, the loan to the brother, the email sent after midnight, with all other judgment left free, as a founder who lost the company on a second bridge rules out ever bridging with personal money again; repairs the standing to decide everything else by quarantining the failure in one move, carried by a rule that needs no understanding to enforce, and alone it drifts, since the banned move is redescribed until it is no longer the banned move, so a witness may hold the description of the move and rule on whether tonight's loan is the loan, never the decisions the ban leaves free; distinct from Which organ, which explains, where the ban only fences.

Which organ: the verdict of unfitness is total, and the repair partitions it, locating the faculty that failed, the calibration, the nerve, the reading of people, the reading of numbers, so the others are released from suspicion, as a woman told for a decade that she cannot be trusted with anything sorts her misses and finds every one was of a person who flattered her and none was of a ledger; repairs standing by narrowing the sentence, carried by the sorted list of past misses, and alone it fails by naming the organ one would least mind losing.

Split the roll from the bet: the past decision is regraded on what was known and knowable when it was made, apart from how it came out, as a poker player reads back the hand and finds the call was right at the odds, or an after-action review finds the platoon leader's route was correct on the map they had; repairs the record by regrading it, carried by the reconstruction of the information at the time, and alone it becomes exculpation, every bad outcome a good bet with bad luck, so it needs a grader who knows the game and did not make the bet.

Stranger's baseline: the same judgment in the same domain is exercised before an audience with no history and no stake, the nurse who floats to another ward, the musician playing a town that never read the review, and the verdict of unfitness turns out to be local; repairs standing by showing the verdict's range rather than its truth, carried by the stranger's ignorance of it, and it needs a stranger, since anyone who has heard the verdict is scoring against it; not Fresh ledger, which keeps the audience and changes the domain.

Verdict refiled as move: the standing verdict of unfitness is reclassified from a finding to a move by discovering whom it served, the manager who needed the employee not to leave, the parent who needed a foil, as an immigrant told his qualifications are worthless learns that the man saying so employs him at half rate; repairs standing by changing the verdict's kind rather than its content, carried by the discovered motive, and alone it fails as paranoia, every correction refiled as a move including the true ones, so it needs a reader with no stake in either verdict.

Second copy of the past: when the verdict came from someone who also narrated the record, the partner who says that never happened, the record itself is the disputed object, and the repair is a copy of the past held outside the narrator's reach, the diary kept before the narration, the friend who was in the room, the dated message; repairs the credibility of memory to its owner, carried by the copy, impossible alone since memory is the defendant, and a copy inside the narrator's house is no copy.

Borrowed bookkeeper: the tally of calls and outcomes is kept by someone with no stake in the person's fitness and no access to their revisions, as a founder after a blown company gives a friend the log and the right to read it back unedited; repairs the credibility of the record to its own subject, carried by custody outside the subject's revising hand, and it cannot be done alone by definition, while a bookkeeper with a stake in the verdict, a spouse, a rival, a creditor, returns the score to the teller's hands.

Borrowed reliance: someone who has not heard the verdict acts on the person's judgment before the person does, the newcomer who asks the disgraced sponsor which meeting to go to, the young officer who asks the cashiered colonel about the ground; repairs standing from the outside in, since the judgment is seen working in another's hands before it is trusted in one's own, carried by the borrower's ignorance of the verdict, impossible alone, and it fails when the borrowed call goes wrong, since the stake has doubled and the hide reopens.

Late apprenticeship: the judgment is submitted to a master in a new craft at an age when submission is not expected, as a dismissed manager of forty begins as a joiner's apprentice, and being wrong becomes the ordinary daily condition graded by someone whose grade the apprentice did not pick; repairs the meaning of being wrong and rebuilds standing in the master's increments, carried by the master, impossible alone, and ruined by a master who profits from keeping the apprentice one.

Ending the hide: the whole account of the wrongness is told to one person, the covered part included, as a pastor who buried a bad decision about a church loan tells the treasurer the actual sequence; what is repaired is not the judgment but the split, since a person keeping a public account and a private one cannot rely on the private one while actively falsifying the public, and one account can be checked where two cannot; carried by the hearer, impossible alone since a confession to a diary can be edited, and a punishing hearer reopens the hide.

source.register: Mechanistic and concrete: sealed envelopes, floated wards, cashiered officers, church loans, poker read-backs, the joiner's bench, a sauce that breaks; drawn from freelancers, founders, nurses, clergy, soldiers, musicians, immigrants, and the trades where the material scores the hand.
source.mode: Analytical mechanisms with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. The alone-and-witnessed failure modes are authored inferences, not clinical findings, and no item is invented-world. Verdict refiled as move and Stranger's baseline make a claim about the locality of a verdict that is analytical, not a claim that every verdict of unfitness is local.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a clinical taxonomy or a partition; no claim that any repair works for a particular person, and the alone-and-witnessed failure modes are authored inferences from cases, not findings. Most real repairs run several items at once.

The seriation is an itinerary of when a witness may enter, not a ranking of strength, speed, or order of use; map edges are conditional authored claims. The axis says when a witness may enter and not what it may do: Honest kitchen calls a watcher at the bench the repair's ruin and Late apprenticeship calls a master at the bench the whole repair, and the map does not own that difference.

The illustrative cases (the cashiered colonel, the floating nurse, the trader who sails, the half-rate employer) are composites simplified to one mechanism each; the poker read-back and the after-action review are named practices, not evidence that the mechanism succeeds.

Adjacent to witness-architectures: Borrowed bookkeeper and Second copy of the past share the custody mechanism of that map's Arm's-length custody. What they add is that the custody is held against the subject's own revising hand or against a narrator who lives in the subject's house, and the thing repaired is the subject's reliance on the record, not the record's standing before others.

Repairs of the relation with the teller, an apology, a retraction, a court's finding in one's favor, are outside: they swap the source of the verdict and exercise the same deference that was the injury. Bodily signals that precede a call are left to somatic-signals; composure inside a live negotiation is left to negotiator-check-loops.

seriation.axis: When the witness may enter: from repairs that fail if anyone is present while the judgment is exercised (nobody at the stove, nobody holding the key), through repairs a dated seal or a count can stand in for, to repairs that need a grader or a stranger after the fact, to repairs that are nothing but the witness (the bookkeeper, the borrower, the master, the hearer).
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of strength or a prescribed order. Honest kitchen opens it because the only witness it tolerates is the medium, and Fresh ledger now stands beside it, moved on the critic's reading of the axis: the new domain scores the hand itself, and the only witness the ledger tolerates holds the return date, as One-turn key's holds the calendar. Ending the hide closes the walk because there the hearer is the whole repair. Silent minority report → Sealed slip is the hinge: the two are the same object, a dated note the writer cannot amend, differing only in which way the seal faces. Sealed against the self it guards one call's content from memory, a witness may hold it from the start, and it leaves the choosing of envelopes unfixed; sealed against the room it guards the writer's pre-fold view from her own post-fold rewriting, silent because whoever can afford the minuted dissent does not need the file, so the seal must carry a date on which it turns around and someone else opens it. The middle of the walk, Weather rule through Split the roll from the bet, is where the witness enters afterward, as the reader of the catalogue, the holder of the ban's wording, or the grader of the hand, and after the repairs each item in that band says so in its own text; the told-case repairs (Stranger's baseline, Verdict refiled as move, Second copy of the past) cluster past that point because each presupposes a record the person cannot read alone.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does someone rebuild a working reliance on their own judgment after being badly wrong, what does each repair and carry, and which of them need a witness or are ruined by one?
exploration.changed_question: Breath one treated the two origins in the pointer, being wrong and being told so, as one injury, and treated the witness as present or absent. Every breath-one repair reads the person's own record, and in the told case the record was narrated by the teller, so the repairs that need no witness are exactly the ones that are unavailable. The question became: which repairs can be run on a record the person cannot read, who must hold the copy, and when may the witness enter, at the stove, at the sealing, at the opening, or as the user of the result, rather than whether.
exploration.new_member: Silent minority report: when the room overrules the judgment, the overruled view is written and dated before folding, not spoken, and read back against the outcome months later, as a junior analyst keeps a private file of every forecast she was talked out of; repairs the survival of the person's own view across their own fold, since a view one folded on is the easiest to remember afterward as never held, and a dissent spoken and minuted is a different instrument that repairs standing before the room rather than before oneself; carried by the dated private note, silent because whoever can afford to speak the dissent does not need the file, so the file is the cheap trial of the expensive act; needs a witness later, since a file only its author reads is a slip without a seal, and the note must carry the date on which someone else opens it, or it becomes a second life.

priorities.item: Silent minority report: when the room overrules the judgment, the overruled view is written and dated before folding, not spoken, and read back against the outcome months later, as a junior analyst keeps a private file of every forecast she was talked out of; repairs the survival of the person's own view across their own fold, since a view one folded on is the easiest to remember afterward as never held, and a dissent spoken and minuted is a different instrument that repairs standing before the room rather than before oneself; carried by the dated private note, silent because whoever can afford to speak the dissent does not need the file, so the file is the cheap trial of the expensive act; needs a witness later, since a file only its author reads is a slip without a seal, and the note must carry the date on which someone else opens it, or it becomes a second life.
priorities.why: It is the hinge of the walk and the cheapest repair to run: a file, a date, and a second reader. It also tests the map's central claim directly, that the direction of the seal is what decides when a witness may enter, at the sealing or only at the opening.
priorities.next_question: An overruled operator keeps every folded view in a dated file for ninety days with a fixed opening date and a named opener; on that date count separately how many folded views were right and, the following month, how many times the operator still folds in the room after reading the file. Only the second count measures the repair; if the first is high and the second unchanged, the report has become a second life.

priorities.item: Verdict refiled as move: the standing verdict of unfitness is reclassified from a finding to a move by discovering whom it served, the manager who needed the employee not to leave, the parent who needed a foil, as an immigrant told his qualifications are worthless learns that the man saying so employs him at half rate; repairs standing by changing the verdict's kind rather than its content, carried by the discovered motive, and alone it fails as paranoia, every correction refiled as a move including the true ones, so it needs a reader with no stake in either verdict.
priorities.why: Low readiness and a live failure mode: refiling a verdict as a move is the repair most likely to run away, since the same operation that frees a person from a bad verdict can free them from every correction. Whether a no-stake reader can hold the line between the two is unmapped.
priorities.next_question: Take one person's list of verdicts received over ten years and have a stranger sort each by whether the deliverer gained from the person believing it, without the person present. Then check which of the person's own pending calls this month they act on after seeing the sorted list. If the refiling changes every call, including ones in domains no verdict touched, the mechanism has become paranoia and the reader did not hold.

gate.standard: declared type, close-neighbor discriminator, boundary case, and form inference
gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing the witness mechanism of Silent minority report, the alone-failure of Sealed slip, and adding the witness clause the type requires to Weather rule, Move ban, and Fresh ledger; on the critic's notes Fresh ledger was moved beside Honest kitchen and the Which organ → One-turn key tine of the fork was added as a seventh edge; no item cut, no neighbor pair collapsed.

neighbors.left: Silent minority report: when the room overrules the judgment, the overruled view is written and dated before folding, not spoken, and read back against the outcome months later, as a junior analyst keeps a private file of every forecast she was talked out of; repairs the survival of the person's own view across their own fold, since a view one folded on is the easiest to remember afterward as never held, and a dissent spoken and minuted is a different instrument that repairs standing before the room rather than before oneself; carried by the dated private note, silent because whoever can afford to speak the dissent does not need the file, so the file is the cheap trial of the expensive act; needs a witness later, since a file only its author reads is a slip without a seal, and the note must carry the date on which someone else opens it, or it becomes a second life.
neighbors.right: Sealed slip: a small prediction is written, dated, and put where the writer cannot amend it before the outcome arrives, as a dismissed forecaster keeps a drawer of dated envelopes on the week's weather; repairs calibration, carried by the seal rather than by any person, and the seal guards only the content, since the grader is still the defendant, who can no longer revise an envelope but still chooses which ones to open and count, so alone it fails by selection where it no longer can by revision; not the count of calls, which is Long denominator's work, and not custody of the whole drawer, which is Borrowed bookkeeper's, but one call's honesty.
neighbors.separating_case: An analyst who writes her forecast on a dated slip and hands it to the meeting's chair to hold: a sealed slip, since she can no longer amend it, and not a minority report, since the room now holds her dissent, and a dissent the room holds is the minuted instrument that repairs standing before the room, not the survival of her own view across her fold. The same analyst who, after being overruled, writes the same forecast in a private file: a minority report, and a sealed slip only if the file carries a date on which someone other than she opens it, since a file only she reads she can also edit. The object is the same; the direction the seal faces is the whole difference.

checks.boundary_case: An apology or retraction from the one who delivered the verdict is out: it looks like restored standing, but it replaces one external verdict with another and exercises the same deference that was the injury, and it leaves the repair in the teller's gift. Verdict refiled as move is in on exactly that contrast, since there the person changes the kind of thing the verdict is, and the teller need never speak.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork at Which organ that the walk conceals: the same partition routes to Sealed slip when the failed organ is calibration, to One-turn key when it is nerve, now an edge of its own on the critic's note, and to Second copy of the past when the list of misses was supplied by the teller, so the told case cannot begin where the wrong case begins. It shows a dependency, Second copy of the past → Split the roll from the bet, which the walk hides by placing the retrospective four items before the copy: on a re-narrated record the retrospective grades the narrator. It shows a passage between levels at Honest kitchen → Borrowed reliance, where a verdict from the world becomes standing among people only if the witness enters as a user and not as a watcher. It shows an incompatibility at the two ends of the walk, Silent minority report → Ending the hide, resolved only by a dated seal: an unopened report is the hiding that the confession exists to end. And it shows a fallback fork at Split the roll from the bet → Move ban, where a retrospective that cannot name the organ hands off to a rule that needs no understanding, with an obligation to return.
checks.target_preserved: The Fable critic (fresh context, 2026-09-07) judged the target preserved: it tried to collapse Sealed slip into Borrowed bookkeeper, Honest kitchen into Fresh ledger and Late apprenticeship, and Stranger's baseline into Borrowed reliance, and each pair separated on a case; the strange members survive the repairs as mechanisms (the repair a witness ruins, the dissent sealed against the room and opened later, the verdict refiled as a move, the key no witness may hold, the copy of one's past held in another's house), and the Honest kitchen / Late apprenticeship disagreement about a master at the bench was left standing rather than domesticated.

name: pressure-transmutations
of: A mechanism by which load on a person appears as a form somewhere else with a shape of its own, a skill, an illness, a joke, a cruelty, a business, a silence, a rule, named with the carrier that routes it, what the form does with the load, spend it, hold it, grow it, move it to another body, or outlive it, and, where one exists, the tell that says which; a form whose removal returns the load whole and unchanged is parking, not transmutation, and is out.
items: Beat: a continuous load nobody could carry whole is cut into units each of which can be, and the cut is kept by a pulse, as the shanty turns a haul that would not end into a hundred pulls that each do, a monthly payment turns an unpayable sum into a payable one, and the prisoner counts days rather than the sentence; carried by the period rather than by any strength, and the form has a life of its own, since the song is sung ashore; it spends the load one unit at a time, and the load returns whole only if the pulse stops before the haul is done.

Anecdote that wears smooth: the thing that happened is told, and each telling files an edge until the story has a shape that can be told by someone who was not there, as the veteran's night under fire becomes, by the fortieth telling, a dinner story with a laugh in it; carried by the retelling, and the load is spent in the filing, since a story that has become about a character is no longer about the teller; not the silence, which is the same event held by never being told, and the tell that this one is spent is that the teller can now be interrupted.

Gallows round: a joke is built ahead of the moment and passed around a crew, so that when the load arrives it lands in a container two or ten can hold at once, as night nurses and bomb-disposal teams keep a stock of lines that outsiders find monstrous; carried by the joke's being shared rather than by its being funny, and the form has a shape of its own, since the lines are kept and taught to new hands; it spends what the crew can laugh off together and returns the remainder to each member alone, which is why the round is loudest on the wards with the most to hold; not the timing of the volatile house, which is one person's skill, and not the funeral laugh, which is overflow with nothing built for it.

Bill on release: the body keeps the account while the load is on, as if settling it would cost the person the hours they need, and presents it the day the load lifts, as the migraine that arrives the morning after the deadline, the fever on the first day of the holiday, the shaking that begins only once the car has stopped; carried by deferral, and the form is an illness with a calendar; it spends the load in one payment, so what it shows is the cost of the vessel that was holding it, and the map's reading, not a measurement, is that the bill is largest after the longest hold; not the body's no, which comes during the load and lifts with it.

Second self: a character is grown to stand where the load lands so the person does not have to, the ward voice, the stage name, the manager's face, as a shy man keeps a persona who is not shy whom the audience meets while he watches from behind it; carried by the split, and the form is a person other people know; it holds the load rather than spending it, so the bill is paid on the day the persona is set down, and a persona kept up long enough is held against its own bill rather than against anything in the world; not the silence, which hides the load, since the persona is on show.

Fear with a ledger: a fear that would otherwise wander is given a place where it can be satisfied, and there it does the work, checking every column twice, as an accountant raised in a house where mistakes were dangerous is the most exact in the firm and could not tell you why; carried by the fear itself, which is the worker, and the form is a competence others pay for; it holds the load and keeps it working, so the retired accountant counts the change twice at the grocer's, since the fear is in the person and the ledger was only where it was put, and the bullied boy's shoulders are the same worker in a different tissue; not an amulet, where the load rides in an object and comes back whole when the object is lost.

Last acre: when the domain a person can order shrinks, the ordering does not shrink with it, and all of it lands on what is left, as a prisoner's cell is kept with a precision no free house has, a man three years out of work keeps a lawn the neighbors photograph, a woman who has lost the say over her days gets the say over her kitchen; carried by the shrinkage of the domain, and the form is an order out of all proportion to what it orders; it holds the load, and the tell is that the order relaxes when the domain widens, which is how it is told from fear with a ledger, where the exactness follows the person into the new job.

The body's no: where a refusal cannot be said, the body says it in the only tender the household or the army accepts, as a conscript whose leg will not bear him on the morning of the march, a daughter whose stomach will not keep food in the house she may not leave; carried by the list of excuses the setting honors, so that the sickness takes the shape of what is allowed, and the form is an illness with a purpose that no one, least of all the sick, has chosen; it holds the load, since the body recovers when the march is cancelled and relapses when it is set again; described from what the household sees, as a phenomenology and not a cause; not the bill on release, which arrives after the load and does not return with it.

Silence with a shape: the load is held by never being spoken, and the not-speaking acquires a shape everyone in the house can trace, the war that is not mentioned, the brother who is not named, the year with no photographs, as the immigrant who stops speaking the language the loss was in; carried by the closed channel, and the form is a topic with edges the household walks around without being told where they are; it holds the load for many in one person, so that when the silence is broken the load does not return to the silent one but lands on the hearers; not the anecdote, which is the same event spent by telling.

Vow that was a verdict: a loss that was imposed is redescribed as chosen and then kept as a rule, so that it is lived as a value rather than suffered as a sentence, as the surgeon demoted to orderly on arrival becomes the most devout man in the parish, and the woman who was not married takes up a celibacy she then honors; carried by the redescription, and the form is a discipline that is actually kept and does real work; it holds the load, and the tell is that the loss returns as loss the day the doctrine is doubted; not piety as such, since what is transmuted is the authorship of the loss.

Grudge battery: the load is given a name and a face and stored as a wrong done by someone, which turns a weight into a charge that can be kept indefinitely and drawn on, as the prisoner who lives fifteen years on the plan for the man who informed; carried by the personification, and the form is an enemy; it holds the load and grows it, since a charge is topped up by every rehearsal, and it is spent only by revenge, after which the one who won the suit or the duel commonly collapses, since the store that was keeping them up is empty; not the vow, which cannot share a house with a wrongdoer.

Shop that dreads: the load is turned into output, and the output acquires dependents, so that the form which took the pressure begins to manufacture it, as the immigrant's dread becomes a restaurant and the restaurant becomes a payroll, a lease, and a Friday it cannot miss; carried first by the deadline's conversion of dread into units and then by the units' dependents, and the form is an institution with a hunger of its own; it grows the load, since stopping returns the pressure with interest and in the names of the staff; not the ledger, which holds one person's fear in one person's hands.

Hunting the fuel: a form built under load runs only under load, so when the load lifts the person goes and finds some, as the writer who cannot write without a deadline, for whom a self-set date does not count, takes a commission he does not want for the date that comes with it, the discharged soldier who takes the night shift on the locked ward, the retired negotiator who picks fights with the parish council; carried by the form's operating condition rather than by any craving for the pressure, and the form is a life arranged around resupply; it grows the load by recruiting it, and the tell is that the form runs at full quality under a manufactured pressure, provided the manufacture carries a cost the person cannot waive, which is how it is told from a broken form.

Downhill delivery: the load is handed by an act to someone with less standing, as a sergeant who has taken the colonel's weather gives it to the private, the manager's dread arrives in the team as a schedule, the beaten child kicks the dog; carried by the status gradient, and the form is a cruelty that seems to belong to the deliverer's character; it moves the load without spending it, and it works, which is why it is stable, since the deliverer is lighter and the receiver has a gradient of their own below; not the lightning rod, which needs no act.

Lightning rod: a group's load lands on one member without anyone delivering it, because the structure routes it there, as a marriage's strain appears in one child's body and not the other's, a platoon's fear settles on the one everyone rides, the department's dread collects on the new hire; carried by the structure, the least-defended place, and the form is a role, the sick one, the clown, the problem; it moves the load and keeps it moved, so that a rod removed is replaced within the season, and the household that loses its sick child finds another; not downhill delivery, which is an act with an author.

Cornered generosity: what is about to be taken is given away first, so that a loss becomes a gift, as the bankrupt buys the whole bar a round, the dying give away the furniture, the tenant gives the neighbours the good chairs the week before the bailiff's van; carried by authorship, since a thing given is a thing one had the say over, and the form is a largesse strangers admire; it moves the load into obligation, since a gift makes a debtor where a seizure would have made only a loss, so the cornered giver ends the night poorer and owed; not a spender in this map's sense, though it spends money, since the load is now held by the people it was given to.

Timing from the volatile house: a child of a dangerous parent learns to read a room's temperature in half a second and to land the line that breaks the tension before the tension breaks something, and the skill outlives the house as comic timing, as the comedian who can feel a room turn and knows to the syllable when the joke must arrive; carried by the anticipatory reading, and the form is a skill strangers pay for without knowing what it was for; it neither spends nor holds the load, since the house is gone, and is a fossil in the kitchen until a room supplies danger again, as the hostile club does, where it becomes a form that hunts its fuel; the tell that it is a fossil and not the ledger's worker in another tissue is the quiet room: if the reading runs where nothing is at stake, a dinner among friends scanned every half second, the fear is still the worker and this is a ledger, and only where the reading sleeps until a room turns is the skill a fossil; not the gallows round, which is a crew's shared container.

Tin of string: a rule made under a load is kept when the load is gone, as the grandmother who lived through the hunger years keeps a tin of string too short to use, the newly rich founder who still cannot leave food on a plate, the professor who still rinses and dries the plastic bags of a stipend spent thirty years ago; carried by the rule's having been learned as a rule rather than as a response, and the form is a habit with nothing behind it; it outlives the load, so removing the form returns nothing, which is the one test this map has for telling a fossil from a vessel: throw the tin out, and if nothing comes back it was a tin, and if dread comes back it never was, which is where the demobbed man who cannot sit with his back to a door belongs, since the door is still doing the fear's work; not fear with a ledger, where the fear is still working, and not an obsolete power still obeyed, which is the same habit seen from the rule's side, where this sees it from the load's, by what removal returns.

source.register: Analytical and phenomenological: described from what the person, the household, the ward, or the crew can see; cases from comedians, accountants, conscripts, night nurses, sergeants, prisoners, immigrants, the long-unemployed, the newly rich, a ship's crew, a potlatch; no clinical vocabulary and no claim about cause.
source.mode: Analytical mechanisms with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one carrier. The fate assigned to each form (spend, hold, grow, move, outlive) is an authored reading of the typical case, not a property of the form, and the edges show forms changing fate. The body's no is phenomenological description of a contested pattern and not a diagnosis; the hydraulic language throughout is a figure; no item is invented-world.
source.via: practice-deep-ideonomy; two Fable fieldwork breaths; independent Fable editorial review
boundary_claim: Authored phenomenology, not a clinical taxonomy: no item is a diagnosis or a claim about cause, and the two illness items describe what the person and the household can see, a calendar and a shape, not an etiology.

The fate assigned to each form (spend, hold, grow, move, outlive) is an authored reading of the typical case, not a property of the form; the edges show forms changing fate, and the itinerary is not a scale of severity or an order a person passes through.

The only test the map offers, remove the form and see what comes back, cannot be run on some forms (a body, a skill), is itself a load, and a form removed from its pressure may go and find more; so the conserve-or-spend question is answered here as a set of tells, not a measurement; and a form whose removal returns the load whole and unchanged (the amulet, the widower's overtime) is parking rather than transmutation and is out, though the map has no item for that parked state from which Shop that dreads and Hunting the fuel grow.

The hydraulic language (load, vessel, spend, charge) is a figure kept for what it lets one notice; no claim is made that pressure is a conserved quantity, and Downhill delivery and Lightning rod describe conservation within a household or a crew only as what an observer of that group sees.

Illustrative cases (the comedian, the accountant, the sergeant, the shanty, the potlatch, the demoted surgeon) are simplified composites exposing one carrier each, not claims about specific persons or histories; forms adopted deliberately as technique are outside except where the chosen form later acquires the mechanism.

seriation.axis: What the form does with the load: from forms that spend it (a beat, a retelling, a shared round, a bill paid on release), through forms that hold it and give it back when removed (a persona, a ledger, a last acre, a body's no, a silence, a vow), to forms that grow it (a grudge, a shop, a form that hunts its fuel), to forms that move it into another body or another's obligation (delivery, the rod, the cornered gift), and finally forms that outlive it (a timing with no house behind it, a tin of string), where removing the form returns nothing.
seriation.note: An authored itinerary, not a scale of severity or a sequence a person passes through, and the fate at each stop is the typical one rather than a property of the form. Beat opens it because nothing is left of the haul but the song; Tin of string closes it because nothing is left behind the form at all. Bill on release → Second self is the hinge: the bill is a spender, one payment on the day the load lifts, but it is the vessel's cost, and once the bill is known the persona is kept up to avoid it, so a spender is what turns a vessel permanent, and the two halves of the walk meet in one household on one morning. Timing from the volatile house sits beside Tin of string rather than among the skills because with the house gone it is a fossil, and its edge to Hunting the fuel says how a fossil is resupplied. The illness items are split by the walk on purpose: The body's no holds and sits among the vessels, Bill on release spends and sits among the spenders, so a household reading one sickness can ask which side of the hinge it is on by its calendar. Timing's place beside Tin of string rests on the fossil reading, which the quiet-room tell added at review makes checkable rather than assumed; the order of the middle three fates (hold, grow, move) claims no adjacency and could be permuted without loss.
